kultivator.cerita.adegan.kakek_lumpur.su: The beggar was a Dao Union master
kultivator.cerita.adegan.sidang.sub: Magistrate Bao's gavel falls three times
kultivator.cerita.adegan.tema_pelabuhan_: The Sea Goddess's palanquin is carried to the quay
The black shark flag above the stern
The junk's sails vanish into the fog
The light guides the ships home again
kultivator.cerita.adegan.topeng.sub: Mo Ying, elder of the demonic path
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_sapa.asal: Yes! My mother keeps an inn there. I... haven't written. Every time I try, I'm ashamed I haven't become anything yet.
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_sapa.hidup: Up before the rooster, sweeping till the sun is high, breathing drills until my legs go numb. Hard, but I can already light a fire without flint!
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_sapa.mulai: What brings you to our sect? ...Sorry, I'm only an outer disciple. I sweep the yard and carry water.
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_sapa.mulai.2: How is life in the sect?
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_tebus.lepas: Take the boy. He sweeps too slowly anyway.
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_tebus.mulai: An outer disciple belongs to the sect until the sect releases him. If you want to take him home, pay, or prove you are stronger than our rules.
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_temu.baca: ...She still puts cinnamon in every letter. (Ah Lun wipes his eyes with his sleeve.) Sorry. Dust. Lots of dust in this yard.
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_temu.mulai: Ah Lun? ...That is me. Mother wrote a letter? My mother?
kultivator.cerita.ah_lun_temu.mulai.1.al: You do not have the letter.
kultivator.cerita.alkemis_sapa.dan_chen: He called me "cracked furnace" for two years. In the third year he called me by my name. I cried in the herb store. Do not tell anyone.
kultivator.cerita.alkemis_sapa.jadi: Start by grinding herbs until your hands smell of soil forever. Then the First Tier trial: one pill, one furnace, no explosion. Most fail at the "no explosion" part.
kultivator.cerita.alkemis_sapa.mulai: Do not touch that furnace. Not because it is hot, but because Elder Dan Chen counts its ashes. What do you need?
kultivator.cerita.alkemis_sapa.mulai.1: How does one become an alchemist?
kultivator.cerita.alkemis_sapa.mulai.2: What is Elder Dan Chen like?
kultivator.cerita.alkemis_sapa.nasihat: The fire must not leap when the third herb goes in. Lower your breath, not the flame; a furnace follows its refiner's breathing. And never refine angry. The pill gets angry too.
kultivator.cerita.awan_tawar.isi: Love letters and mooncakes. And maybe one or two things better left unknown, for the sake of your heart.
kultivator.cerita.awan_tawar.mulai: Need work? This crate must reach its destination, and I must stay here and wait for the wind. Do not open it. Seriously. Do not.
kultivator.cerita.awan_tawar.mulai.1.ala: You do not know where any sky palace is.
kultivator.cerita.awan_tawar.ok: Splendid! May good winds go with you, and if the wind turns bad, run.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_jemput.mulai: Big cultivator? Can I... come with you? Mother says I must be brave. I am brave. A little.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_jemput.mulai.1: Hold my hand. Let us go.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_jemput.mulai.2: Say goodbye to your mother first.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_tawar.mulai: There is a child in this village who makes the well water ripple just by looking at it. The mother is afraid. I... I do not know what to do. You are a cultivator; you know where such a child should go.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_tawar.mulai.1: I will take them to my sect.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_tawar.mulai.2: The nearest sect can teach them.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_tawar.mulai.3: Let them grow up as an ordinary child.
kultivator.cerita.bakat_tawar.terima: The child is by the well. Speak gently; they startle easily, and when startled, the well overflows.
kultivator.cerita.bao_qing_sapa.denda: Come to this desk, name your wrong, pay, leave. Those who flee get their faces on the wanted board. The Yamen painter is very thorough.
kultivator.cerita.bao_qing_sapa.hukum: Only three laws. First: within the walls, swords sleep. Second: debts are paid, promises kept. Third: after the night drum, the gates are closed to all, myself included.
kultivator.cerita.bao_qing_sapa.mulai: The Yamen accepts no bribes, no flattery and no excuses. Other than that, go ahead.
kultivator.cerita.bao_qing_sapa.mulai.2: How do I pay a fine?
kultivator.cerita.bao_qing_sapa.senyum: Once, last year. A thief confessed because he feared his mother, not me. That was funny.
kultivator.cerita.barang.air_mata_air_ro: Clear water that stays cold in the sun. Drawn at a spirit spring.
One jar of spirit water. Enough for three withered plots.
A shivering silver-furred fox kit. Its eyes follow Ma Laoliu everywhere.
A short letter with a sect seal. "Mother, I am well. I can light fire without flint now."
kultivator.cerita.barang.batu_bermata_da: A raw stone with a red vein like an eye. The hand that holds it grows tired.
kultivator.cerita.barang.bekal_kafilah.l: A bag of dry bread, salt, and Lao Qiao's scribbled road map.
kultivator.cerita.barang.cap_bayangan.lo: A black stone seal carved with an upturned lotus. First proof: a demonic sign inside the city.
kultivator.cerita.barang.catatan_pembuku: Pages torn from the money house ledger. Palace money flows into a nameless account.
A black ring as cold as its owner's hand. Collectors at the Grand Auction would pay dearly for it.
kultivator.cerita.barang.gulungan_koan.l: Twelve Dao riddles in a hermit's hand. The right answers are not written.
kultivator.cerita.barang.halaman_resep_k: A brittle page from an inheritance tomb. The ink still smells of sandalwood.
kultivator.cerita.barang.jimat_lentera.l: A prize of the Lantern Festival riddles. The paper is warm like candlelight.
kultivator.cerita.barang.kertas_jimat_hi: A talisman inked in blood. Its pattern belongs to no righteous sect.
kultivator.cerita.barang.kitab_curian.lo: A sect technique manual, its cover wet with rain and sweat.
kultivator.cerita.barang.kristal_urat.lo: A crystal that pulses slowly, like a sleeping heart.
A gold badge marked Keeper of the Throne. Palace doors open without question.
kultivator.cerita.barang.lencana_penyela: Given by Yan Ruyi with a still-trembling hand.
kultivator.cerita.barang.muatan_awan.lor: A crate sealed by Captain Yun Fei. Don't open it, he said, smiling.
kultivator.cerita.barang.pedang_tanpa_na: A jian forged by Young Ou Ye together with you and quenched in a spirit spring. It waits for a name.
kultivator.cerita.barang.pil_penawar_rac: A pale green pill. Its bitterness reaches the bone.
kultivator.cerita.barang.resep_penawar.l: An Alchemist Guild recipe: Spirit Spring Water, Starwort, and a flame that must not waver.
A grass that glows faintly inside a Spirit Vein Cave.
kultivator.cerita.barang.sandal_berdarah: A child's sandal with a broken strap. Found in a back alley of the slums.
kultivator.cerita.barang.surat_bibi_hong: A cinnamon-scented letter for Ah Lun. The writing slants; it was written in tears.
kultivator.cerita.barang.surat_mata_mata: Found behind the temple altar. The hand is the same as Mo Ying's notes.
kultivator.cerita.barang.surat_tuan_muda: Red paper inked in gold. The words are prouder than the hand that wrote them.
kultivator.cerita.barang.tanda_bebas.lor: The captive you freed gave it to you: "Keep it, so you remember us."
kultivator.cerita.barang.tanda_pertapa.l: A small bamboo stick carved with one word: "Still".
kultivator.cerita.barang.wesel_palsu.lor: The seal is almost perfect, but the paper is too new.
kultivator.cerita.batu_tawar.bawa: Do not look at it too long. If your hands start to feel heavy, it is not because of the stone.
kultivator.cerita.batu_tawar.buang: Then someone else picks it up, cuts it, and I read their name on the mourning board. I am sly, not wicked.
kultivator.cerita.batu_tawar.buang.1: Let me take it to the temple.
kultivator.cerita.batu_tawar.mulai: This stone came from the northern mine. My cutter fainted twice holding it, and the third time he dreamt of a red eye. I will not keep it in my house one more night.
kultivator.cerita.batu_tawar.mulai.1: Let me take it to the temple.
kultivator.cerita.batu_uji.benar1: Yes. This stone holds the weariness of every hand that ever cut it. What does it ask for?
kultivator.cerita.batu_uji.benar1.1: To be cut to the end.
kultivator.cerita.batu_uji.benar2: (The monk strikes a small bell. The red vein in the stone fades to grey.) It sleeps now. You should sleep early tonight too.
kultivator.cerita.batu_uji.mulai: Look into its eye. Do not look away. What do you see?
kultivator.cerita.batu_uji.salah: Your eyes are still hungry. Sit a while, drink some water, and we will try again.
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_ah_lun.akhir: Very well... a room is three SV a night.
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_ah_lun.cerit: My son Ah Lun joined a sect in the eastern mountains three seasons ago. Not a letter since.
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_ah_lun.mulai: A room? Of course. But... honoured cultivator, may I ask a small favour?
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_ah_lun.sekte: He said %s. Will you take this letter?
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_ah_lun.terim: May heaven repay your kindness! Tonight's room is free.
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_bahagia.mula: My second child! Sit, sit, eat first. Ah Lun, pour tea for your saviour! ...Look, he can pour without spilling now.
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_sapa.kamar: Three Spirit Value a night, ginger porridge for breakfast. The mattresses were stuffed fresh last month, soft as clouds!
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_sapa.mulai: Welcome! Staying the night or eating? Sit, sit, tea first. Your face is so thin, does your sect not feed you?
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_sapa.teh: Morning dew tea from the southern gardens. Drink slowly; those who rush their tea rush their lives.
kultivator.cerita.bibi_hong_surat.mulai: I keep Ah Lun's letter under my pillow. I read it once every night. He can light fire without flint now, he says! My boy!
kultivator.cerita.dan_chen_sapa.mulai: Hm. Your hands have never governed a flame, have they? The Alchemist Guild is no kitchen. Touch no furnace.
kultivator.cerita.dan_chen_sapa.mulai.1: How does one become a guild alchemist?
kultivator.cerita.dan_chen_sapa.mulai.2: Is it true you stopped a plague?
kultivator.cerita.dan_chen_sapa.ujian: Pass the Alchemist Rank exam. Brew one pill without burning the furnace, without crying, without asking twice. If you are serious, talk to me again with ingredients in hand.
kultivator.cerita.dan_chen_sapa.wabah: The Yellow Leaf plague, forty years ago. My first formula saved half the city. The other half... I still count them every night.
kultivator.cerita.demam_dou.mulai: You brought medicine?! Granny Ma coughed all night, the twins are burning up, and Uncle Tie will not get up from his mat.
kultivator.cerita.demam_tawar.bantu: Refine one pill, whatever you can refine. I need its core, not its effect; I will blend it with lotus root and mint. Then take it to the slums. Little Dou knows which houses are sick.
kultivator.cerita.demam_tawar.mulai: Sorry, I am busy... Red fever in the slums. Eleven people since yesterday, and my fever pills are gone. My own furnace cracked last week.
kultivator.cerita.demam_tawar.tolak: Yes... Thank you for listening. That is medicine too, sometimes.
kultivator.cerita.dou_pulang.mulai: Xiao Tu is home! He says the black robes kept them in a cold cell, and then you came like a general from the stories! Want a sweet? Free, just for you.
kultivator.cerita.dou_sapa.mulai: Catch me if you can! ...Oh, you're new. Want news? One rumour, one sweet!
kultivator.cerita.dou_sapa.rumah: Everywhere! Under the bridge when it rains, on the warehouse roof when it's hot. Grandpa Mud says the world is a house whose doors haven't been shared out yet.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.iblis.0: Hah... you were lucky today. My shadow will not forget your face.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.iblis.1: My blood drips on another's floor. Remember: the demonic path never stays in debt for long.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.iblis.2: Kill me if you dare! ...No? Soft. That is why your kind always loses in the end.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.muda.0: I... lost? No, I was careless! Next time will be different!
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.muda.1: That form of yours... I have never seen anything like it. Teach me? Uh, forget it. I said nothing.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.muda.2: Fine. I admit you are stronger. Today. Only today.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.tua.0: Good. Your hands are honest, your steps calm. These old bones are glad to be beaten like this.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.tua.1: I lose. Do not bow too deeply; you will shame me twice.
kultivator.cerita.duel.kalah.tua.2: Hmm. The waves behind push the waves ahead. That is how it should be.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.iblis.0: Look at you, kneeling in the dust. Go home, and tell your master who spared you.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.iblis.1: Your qi is sweet. A pity I am not hungry today.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.iblis.2: Is that all? Come back once you have learned to hate.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.muda.0: Ha! I told you! Go home and train for ten more years!
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.muda.1: Not bad, for an outsider. You may challenge me again once you stop shaking.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.muda.2: Do not be sad. Losing to me is no shame; everyone loses to me.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.tua.0: Too hasty. An angry sword always arrives first, and always loses first.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.tua.1: Get up. Defeat is an expensive teacher; do not waste its lesson.
kultivator.cerita.duel.menang.tua.2: You have talent. What you lack is patience. It grows slower than talent.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_dendam.maaf: ...Sorry? You think... Hmph. Fine. One bowl of noodles and we are even.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_dendam.mulai: You! This time there is no crowd to laugh at me. Draw.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_dendam.mulai.2: Feng Ao does not believe your words.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_sahabat.mulai: You again. ...I have climbed to third place. Do not smile; it is not because of you. A little because of you.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_sapa.mulai: Hmph. You again. On the Young Dragon List yet? No? Of course not.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_sapa.mulai.2.a: Feng Ao does not spar below Foundation.
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_sapa.sombong: Arrogant? I am only honest sooner than others. My father sells cloth. No one gave me anything. If I do not raise my head, who would see it?
kultivator.cerita.feng_ao_sapa.tanding: Good. No sharp blades, no killing arts. Three falls loses. Ready?
kultivator.cerita.formasi_pasang.mulai: Good, these shards still sing. Hold that end; do not breathe while I count to seven.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_pasang.mulai.1: Teach me to read the carvings.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_sapa.kerja: Two discs carved with the same promise recognise each other, however far apart. The crystals hold the distance, the spirit stones pay for it. The craftsman who carved the first disc here worked nine years without a single wrong stroke.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_sapa.mulai: The array is ready. Name your destination, pay the fare and close your eyes. Those who keep them open usually throw up.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_sapa.tersesat: Once. A salt merchant left for the west and arrived on a temple roof, right on top of the bell. The monk said it was an omen; the merchant said it was a bill.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_tawar.butuh: Fresh amethyst from a geode, eight shards. The old crystal is tired of holding distances. You see, everyone who passes leaves a little of their journey inside it.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_tawar.mulai: Do not stand on the disc! ...Sorry. The north-east pillar has a hairline crack, and if it spreads, travellers might arrive in two pieces.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_tawar.mulai.2: I hope it is fixed soon.
kultivator.cerita.formasi_tawar.tolak: Yes, yes. Everyone hopes. Crystals do not eat hope.
kultivator.cerita.gendut_zhu_sapa.lompat: Me? Jump? N-no! That was... a kitchen move. Not because something ran under the table. Not at all.
kultivator.cerita.gendut_zhu_sapa.mi: One pulled noodle! One Spirit Value, and your smile. Eat it while it's hot!
kultivator.cerita.gendut_zhu_sapa.mulai: Hah! A customer! Pulled noodles, spirit-meat buns, nine-hour bone soup. Choose, choose!
What is the secret of your soup?
Why did you jump just now?
kultivator.cerita.gendut_zhu_sapa.sup: Bones from the beast market, ginger from the southern village, and I sing to it every hour. A soup that is sung to is never bitter.
kultivator.cerita.gerbang_buronan.mulai: You... your face is on the Yamen board. I want no trouble with cultivators. Go to the Yamen and pay your fine before my captain sees you.
I will go to the Yamen.
kultivator.cerita.gerbang_malam.mulai: The gates are closed. Do not look at me like that; I did not beat the drums. If your business is urgent, show a badge or wait for the morning bell.
kultivator.cerita.gerbang_malam.panjang: Every night is long on the wall. An owl perched on my spear for a whole hour tonight. I did not dare move; they say an owl on your spear is good luck.
kultivator.cerita.gerbang_sapa.hukum: This city was founded by seven sects tired of war. They planted seven broken swords in the square and swore an oath. Since then, whoever draws a sword in the street answers to Magistrate Bao. Trust me, you do not want that.
kultivator.cerita.gerbang_sapa.jam: The curfew drums sound after dark; the gates open again with the morning bell. Latecomers sleep in the slums, or in a cell if they climb the wall.
kultivator.cerita.gerbang_sapa.mulai: Welcome. Weapons may come in, so long as they sleep in their sheaths. The city's first law: within the walls, swords sleep.
kultivator.cerita.gu_berkuasa.ajudan: Mo Ying? He... disappeared a month ago. Strange. He never forgot a single figure, yet he forgot to say goodbye.
kultivator.cerita.gu_berkuasa.mulai: The shops are full, the east wall is mended, and fines are up by a quarter. You do not like it? Order is expensive, friend. Someone must pay for it, and better the ones who break it.
kultivator.cerita.gu_dipimpin_ruyi.mulai: Lady Ruyi asked me to stay at the treasury. I accepted. A defeat that pays a salary is still a salary, and I still count faster than anyone in the palace.
kultivator.cerita.gu_lianshan_sapa.ajuda: Mo Ying, my aide. Diligent, careful, never forgets a single figure. Sometimes I forget he is in the room.
kultivator.cerita.gu_lianshan_sapa.lelan: Eight lots, bidders from nine sects, and a commission large enough to mend the east wall. Come when the auction bell rings; I often bid myself.
kultivator.cerita.gu_lianshan_sapa.mulai: Ah, a new face with an aura that is not cheap. This city prospers because people like you bring spirit stones. How may I help?
What do you think of the heir?
Tell me about the Grand Auction.
Who is that man behind you?
kultivator.cerita.gu_lianshan_sapa.pewar: Lady Ruyi has a heart of gold. Sadly, a heart of gold cannot pay forty guards. The city needs hands that can count.
kultivator.cerita.jasa.tutup: That service is closed right now.
kultivator.cerita.jing_xin_sapa.cermin: In a cave outside the city lies a pool that reflects not faces but intentions. A monk once saw his own demon there and laughed until he wept. That monk was my teacher.
kultivator.cerita.jing_xin_sapa.doa: Incense is on the left. Prayer needs no voice; heaven hears what is not said.
kultivator.cerita.jing_xin_sapa.iblis: A heart demon is not defeated; it is recognised. When you can say its name without anger, it is only a shadow.
kultivator.cerita.jing_xin_sapa.mulai: Let the bell clear your heart. Sit a while, if you like.
kultivator.cerita.jing_xin_sapa.mulai.1: How does one calm a heart demon?
kultivator.cerita.juara_sapa.arena: This is where sects settle disputes: two champions, one stage, everyone watching. A little blood is cheaper than war, and the peanut sellers get richer.
kultivator.cerita.juara_sapa.gigi: My two front teeth. My first tournament, my first opponent, his first strike. I won that bout. My teeth did not.
kultivator.cerita.juara_sapa.mulai: You look at the lei tai like someone who wants to climb it. Everyone does at first. Then they see my teeth on the floor, and change their mind.
kultivator.cerita.juara_sapa.mulai.3: Tell me about the Grand Arena.
kultivator.cerita.juara_sapa.tanding: One round, until one of us yields. No stakes, no grudges. If you win, I buy the noodles. If you lose, you do.
kultivator.cerita.jurnal.kosong: Nothing written yet. Talk to the people of towns and villages.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_festival_l: Lantern Festival tonight! A riddle hangs on every lantern. Answer right and win a charm; answer wrong and be laughed at.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_festival_p: Harvest Festival! The granary is full, the drums are playing, and the village head dances though his knees protest.
There is a rice-carrying race on the village green. Last year's champion was the village head's son; this year, they say, a buffalo.
The first harvest offering lies at the Earth God's shrine. The children are forbidden to taste it; they taste it anyway.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_gelombang_: War drums! A beast tide is coming from the forest! Everyone indoors, guards to the walls!
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_hari_gerba: Gate Opening Day! The sects set up stalls in the square, and every mother brings her child to be tested.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_jam_malam_: The curfew drums have sounded. Whoever is still in the street had better have a good reason, and a lantern.
The gate guards say every night some cultivator tries to leap the wall after the drums. Every morning they are in a cell.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_lelang_agu: The Grand Auction bell rings! Bidders from nine sects have come; they say there is a treasure nobody has ever seen.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_lonceng_pa: The morning bell! The gates open, the vegetable sellers jostle in, and the market cats are already waiting for fish.
The bell keeper has struck the morning bell for forty years. He says he can do it asleep, and sometimes he does.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_pasar_mala: The night market is open! Lantern stalls line the way to the east gate. Remember to haggle down by half.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_pertemuan_: The Pill Meeting has begun at the Alchemist Guild! Smoke from eight furnaces is making the birds dizzy.
Sect envoys gather in the Meeting Hall. The palace guard stands twice as close as usual.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.acara_turnamen_a: The Grand Inter-Sect Tournament begins! The Arena seats sold out at dawn; the peanut sellers are suddenly rich.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.ah_lun_pulang: Ah Lun is home! %s freed him from a demonic sect. Bibi Hong cooked for three days straight.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.ah_lun_surat: Bibi Hong finally got a letter from her son. They say %s carried it all the way to the mountains.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.bakat_sekte: A village child with a pure water root was taken in by a sect. %s brought them there.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.binatang_evolusi: %s's spirit beast evolved! Its roar was heard three villages away, they say.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.demam_gratis: The red fever in the slums has broken. The children there call %s the "Sky Healer", and nobody paid a single chip.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.demam_jual: Fever medicine for the slums finally came, from %s. Cheap, they say. The slum folk say "cheap" is a rich man's word.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.harta_diklaim_1: That heavenly treasure has an owner now: %s. Three rivals went home with torn robes, they say.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.harta_diklaim_2: %s took the treasure born in the mountains. The treasure hunters drank till dawn to console themselves.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.harta_lahir_1: Rainbow light came down near the mountains. Three bands of cultivators set out last night.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.harta_lahir_2: The earth trembled and smelled of a flower that never grows here. A heavenly treasure is born, say the elders.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kafilah_selamat: Lao Qiao reached town with his caravan whole. He says %s drove off the bandits like shooing chickens.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kejahatan_1: The guards are looking for %s. If you see them, do not get in the way; the guards hate questions.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kejahatan_2: %s's face is painted on the Yamen board. The Yamen painter is very thorough; he even painted the mole.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.buron: %s's face is posted on the Yamen board. Magistrate Bao signed the warrant himself.
The gate guards were given a portrait of %s. They stare at it a long time; the Yamen painter is known for exaggerating noses.
If you see %s, stay out of it. The Yamen offers a reward, but some who tried to catch them never came home.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.festi: Lantern Festival in %s tonight! The girls have been folding lotus lanterns since dawn, and the young men pretend not to notice.
The riddle keeper says this year there is a lantern in %s nobody has answered in three festivals.
Lantern Street in %s is bright as day. The pickpockets are happy too; mind your purse.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.hari_: Gate Opening Day in %s! The sects set up their stalls, and every mother combs her child's hair three times.
They say last year in %s a tofu seller's child had a heavenly spirit root. Now every tofu seller brings their child.
The spirit-root queue in %s snakes all the way to the main road. The rice-cake sellers went home with empty baskets before noon.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.juara: %s won the Pill Meeting! Elder Dan Chen nodded twice, and the old alchemists went home sour-faced.
The smoke of %s's pill had seven layers of colour, say witnesses in the stands. Another says five. All agree it smelled sweet.
The Alchemist Guild apprentices are copying %s's notes in secret. Their elders pretend not to see.
%s is champion of the Grand Tournament! The peanut sellers at the Arena sold out twice.
%s's name is carved on the Grand Arena's champion stone. The carver grumbles; the name is long and the stone is hard.
The children in the alleys play "being %s" with wooden swords. The loser has to play the opponent.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.kota_: The beast tide broke through the gates of %s. The shops closed for a day, and the Black Market suddenly sells wound salve at double price.
Three roofs in %s were crushed by spirit beasts. The craftsmen say they will fix them; the guards say next time they will hold the wall.
The mourning bell rings in %s. The Warden Prince lit the incense himself at the Founders' Monument.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.perta: The beast tide was driven back from the walls of %s! The butchers sell fangs as charms; half of them are pig teeth.
The guards of %s drank till dawn in the drum tower. Their captain did not drink; he counted who did not come home.
The walls of %s held again. The old men say they were built of stone from seven mountains, so the beasts smell seven sects.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.perte: Sect envoys gather in the Meeting Hall of %s; %s seats are filled. The palace guards say the empty seats are louder than the full ones.
The Sect Meeting in %s: %s envoys, one round table, and nobody willing to sit nearest the door.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kota_besar.tamu_: %s was received in audience at the Warden's Palace! The ministers whisper behind their sleeves.
The palace servants say %s drank tea with the Warden Prince and did not spill a drop. That is harder than it sounds.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.kristal_formasi_: The teleport station glows violet again. %s brought amethyst for the array keeper; nobody arrives in two pieces any more.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.langit_bulan_1: Two moons in the sky! The hermits say such a night is good for breakthroughs. My grandmother says it is good for sleeping.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.langit_bulan_2: A twin-moon night. The well water rose half a hand, and the fish swim in circles.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.langit_gerhana_1: Since the Blood Eclipse, doors are locked early. Even the dogs will not go out.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.langit_gerhana_2: The moon is red again. The elders burn incense and make the children sleep in the middle of the house.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.langit_meteor_1: A star shower tonight! People say every falling star is a spirit stone. People say many things.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.langit_meteor_2: The children climbed onto the roofs to count falling stars. The guards climbed up too, pretending to keep watch.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.lonceng_dituang: Tonight the craftsmen cast bronze in the temple yard. It smells like rain on iron.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.lonceng_pulih: The temple bell rings clear again! Monk Jing Xin smiled all day.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.naga_muda_dendam: Feng Ao swore revenge on %s. He trains past midnight in the guild yard.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.naga_muda_sahaba: Feng Ao climbed to third on the Young Dragon List, and he bought %s noodles! Feng Ao, buying for someone!
kultivator.cerita.kabar.panen_selamat: The rice in that village is green again. The villagers call %s the guest sent by heaven.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.pedang_ayah_baru: Ou Ye reforged an old sword for a palace guard's family. His father's name is now carved on the blade. All thanks to %s.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.pedang_ayah_lama: That palace guard wears his father's sword again, with a silver scar across it. They say %s took it to Ou Ye.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.perbaikan.mohon_: The master builder is looking for volunteers. Anyone who carries planks gets lunch.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.perbaikan.rendah: %s paid for the damage without being asked, though everyone feared them. Maybe the strong are not always cruel.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.perbaikan.rusak_: Savage beasts damaged %s pieces of building here. The craftsmen are measuring the damage.
A cultivator destroyed %s pieces of building here. The master builder is drawing up the bill.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.perbaikan.sahaba: %s helped the craftsmen carry planks all day. A cultivator who sweats! How rare.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.perbaikan.selesa: Repairs done: %s pieces of building restored. The craftsmen are drinking tea under the new roof.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.perbaikan.tagiha: %s paid the damages to the last chip. An honest one! The master builder bowed twice.
Stay away from %s... they wrecked this place and nobody dares send the bill.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_batu_berma: Lao Shi's cursed stone was put to sleep at the temple. The stonecutters can sleep soundly again.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_murid_kabu: The runaway sect disciple was found. The manual is back, and his elder, they say, shouts less often now.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_pedang_tan: Young Ou Ye forged a nameless sword with %s. They say the blade hums when its owner is sad.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_peta_awan: Captain Yun Fei's cargo reached its destination unopened. Yun Fei lost a bet with himself.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_resep_hila: The last page of the Nine Dews Formula was found in an old tomb! The Alchemist Guild is as busy as a market.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_tiga_ujian: The hermit on the northern slope left his cave. They say he found a student, %s, and went wandering in peace.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_tikus_dapu: The spirit rat in Fat Zhu's kitchen was caught! His soup is now called "Hero's Soup".
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_tungku_per: There is a new alchemist on the Alchemist Guild board: %s. Elder Dan Chen said "not bad", which is his highest praise.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_warisan_bo: Someone inherited the legacy of Shi Ban, The Stone Bearer, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Tie Gu, Iron Bones, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Pan Yue, The Walking Mountain, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.

Someone inherited the legacy of Yan Zhuo, Ash Phoenix, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Chi Yao, The Second Sun, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.quest_warisan_ic: Someone inherited the legacy of Bai Shuang, Keeper of the Frozen Seed, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Han Yue, Cold Moon, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Xue Wuhen, Traceless Snow, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.

Someone inherited the legacy of Ye Ying, Night Shade, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Wu Ying, The Shadowless, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.

Someone inherited the legacy of Xu Kong, Keeper of the Rift, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Tai Xu, The Great Void, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
