Someone inherited the legacy of Ling Xuanyi, The Unsheathed Blade, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
Someone inherited the legacy of Jian Wuya, Boundless Sword Sovereign, from an ancient tomb. They say the name is %s.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.rubah_pulang: Ma Laoliu's spirit fox kit is back. %s cleared the bandit camp by the road single-handed.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.segel_pecah_1: They say an ancient prison seal has cracked. The sect elders gathered and will speak to no one.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.segel_pecah_2: Birds flew south in the middle of summer. When birds flee, we had better be ready too.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_damai: %s sent envoys of peace. The market merchants are relieved; iron got a little cheaper.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_perang: %s has declared war! The caravans are detouring by the southern road.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_perang_npc: %s fought its neighbour sect in the valley. The merchants are waiting at the post until the dust settles.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_putus: The pact with %s is broken. People say it was over one disciple and one spilled cup of tea.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_sekutu: %s signed a pact in the Meeting Hall. Two sects, one cup of wine, a thousand whispers.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_serangan: %s raided another sect's land. The smoke could be seen from the imperial road.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_tumbuh: %s keeps growing. They are building a new hall and recruiting disciples from three villages.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sekte_turnamen: The sect tournament is over. The champion is toasted in every teahouse; the losers train until midnight.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.sepi: No news today. Folk only talk about the price of rice.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.situs_gua: %s found a cave that is on no map. The map sellers have already raised their prices.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab2: Someone saw men in black robes slipping in and out of the slums at night.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab2_hila: The slum children never came home. The guards say they ran away. Nobody believes it.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab3: Heir Yan is ill again... The palace physicians say her breath smells of iron.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab3_lema: The heir lives, but cannot stand for long. The merchants whisper that Minister Gu is the better choice.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab4: Prince Yan is withdrawing! The teahouses are taking bets: Lady Ruyi or Minister Gu?
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab5: Magistrate Bao has not slept in three nights. When Magistrate Bao does not sleep, someone in this city is about to lose sleep too.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab5_ters: The case of the missing was closed. Magistrate Bao refused to sign it.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab6: Since the sky turned red, doors are locked earlier. People say the shadows in the east alleys move on their own.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab6_bert: The east gate held, but half the granary burned. Today's porridge is thinner.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab7: Lanterns hung at noon! The coronation is near; Fat Zhu has been cooking since dawn.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab7_gu: Lord Gu raised the fines by a quarter. The Black Market was raided twice this week.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_bab7_ruyi: Lady Ruyi opened the granaries on her first day. In the slums people light incense for her.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_dukung_gu: The guild heads chose Minister Gu. They say the price of salt will fall.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_dukung_ru: Three guild heads signed their backing for Lady Ruyi. The cloth merchants of the east market are sulking.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_gerhana_m: The eclipse night was broken at the east gate. Tie Hu says %s fought like two guards at once.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_sidang: An open trial at the Yamen! The Minister's aide was a demonic elder, and he fled through the roof. %s brought the proof.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_suap: The case of the missing was suddenly closed. The smoke from the Minister's aide's chimney smelled of paper.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_tawanan_p: %s brought the slum children home. Dou laughed and cried at once.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.takhta_topeng: There was a fight in a Cloud District warehouse last night. The salt crates broke open: black talismans inside. Someone's mask broke too.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tawanan_pulang: A captive of the demon lair came home, escorted by %s. Their mother ran out barefoot.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tempat_rusak_1: Someone damaged buildings here. The craftsmen have measured and counted, and they do not look happy.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tempat_rusak_2: Half the roofs in that corner collapsed. The master builder says three days, if it does not rain.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tikus_roh: They say there is a spirit rat the size of a puppy in Fat Zhu's kitchen. No wonder his soup has less meat.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.tuan_muda_kalah: The clan's young master was beaten before his whole village by %s. He greets outsiders politely now.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_00: They say salt went up again. The caravan from the coast is three days late.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_01: The baker's boy at the end of the street has a spirit root, they say. His mother already bought a disciple's robe, though the trial is not until next month.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_02: If you go to %s, do not drink tea at the stall by the gate. The tea is thin, the price is thick.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_03: The peddler Lao Qiao says the roads to the western towns are full of bandits. He went that way himself yesterday, somehow.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_04: A sect in the mountains is looking for new disciples. %s, they say. Its stair has a thousand steps; half the candidates give up halfway.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_05: Do not camp by the river these three nights. The fishermen saw blue light under the water.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_06: My grandmother says when the wind smells of iron, a cultivator nearby is breaking through.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_07: The Cultivators' Guild posted a new mission: a beast den in the eastern woods. The reward is big, the odds are small.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_08: Feng Ao climbed the Young Dragon List again. They say he never sleeps, only meditates standing up.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_09: The monk at the temple says the bell rang by itself last night. There was no wind.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_10: The smith in the next village forged a hoe blade that cuts stone. The farmers queue all the way down the road.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_11: They say %s once turned down a clan young master's proposal with a single sword form. Then married him a year later.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_12: The rains came on time this year. The village head lights incense for the Earth God every morning; perhaps that is why.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_13: There is a hermit in a cave on the northern slope. Those who bring him old herbs sometimes come home calmer.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_14: Stay away from the old tomb past the hill. Every full moon light leaks from its stele. An ancestor's tomb, they say.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_15: At the road post there is a horse that can count to three. Its owner charges one chip per count.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_16: The milestones on the imperial road were carved by the old road kings. If one says ten li, it is ten li, not a step less.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_17: The guards say there is a thief who climbs walls without hands. We say it is a cat. The guards do not like that.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_18: Captain Yun Fei says his cloud ship once hit a bird as big as a house. Nobody believes it, but everyone wants to hear it again.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_19: Fat Zhu is making his nine-hour bone soup again. If you smell ginger from the market, that is the soup.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_20: Bibi Hong at the inn asks every guest about her son. If you go to a mountain sect, bring her some news.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_21: Madam Qian at the Money House never forgets a single chip. They say she counts in her sleep.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_22: One-Eyed Lao Shi says this week's raw stones are good. Lao Shi always says that.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_23: The Beast Market has a new spirit wolf cub. Ma Laoliu refuses to sell it to anyone he dislikes, which is nearly everyone.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_24: Master Wen at the library lost his spectacles again. They are on his head. Again.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_25: In the slums there is an old man who sleeps in the mud every season. Strangely he never falls ill, and the stray dogs respect him.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_26: They say a demonic sect is buying children in the border villages. If a black-robed man bargains for a child, tell the guards.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_27: Fishermen found a fish scale as big as a winnowing tray at the river mouth. Some say a dragon, some say a fish that ate too much.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_28: A pill seller at the market sells "Long Life Pills". The grandfather who bought them died last week, aged one hundred and two.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_29: The moon is full tonight. The children are making lanterns from oiled paper. When the festival comes, this city will be a river of light.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_30: The craftsman at the road post says the west bridge cracked under a cultivator's overladen cart. The cultivator says the bridge was old.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_31: Magistrate Bao punishes a minister's son like a sweeper's son. Half the city loves him; the other half fears him.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_32: News from %s: they need stonemasons and pay in pills. Real pills, they say.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_33: Be careful of %s. Their disciples smile kindly, but no one has ever seen them eat lunch.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_00: In the East Market a stall sells "dragon tears". It is well water and salt. It sells well.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_01: The Sky Watch Tower was lit all night. The watchers say a star moved one hand's width. The drunks say every star moved.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_02: If you pass through the Palace District, do not stare at the guards too long. They are not allowed to smile, and they hate it.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_03: The Grand Library added another shelf. Master Wen wept with joy, then forgot where it was.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_04: The cloud ship from the north is two days late. The dock porters say its captain stopped to fish for clouds. Whatever that means.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_05: The teleport array is humming louder than usual. Its keeper says that is normal. Its keeper also says he is not nervous.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_06: In the Healers' Hall there is a bed that is always empty. They say nobody ever recovered in it, so nobody will lie there.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_07: The Grand Arena is being swept. The sweepers found three teeth, two rings and one broken sword that still trembles.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_08: The schoolchildren of the Scholars' District must memorise the city's first law: "Within the walls, swords sleep." They recite it while fighting with brooms.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_09: The stonecutter at the Source Stone House says he can hear which stones hold jade. He is also deaf in one ear.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_10: The Thousand Blades Pavilion displays a sword said to have cut the rain. The sword is rusty; the price is not.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.umum_kb_11: The ministers argued over the salt tax again. Gu Lianshan won again. The salt merchants celebrate; the salt farmers do not.
kultivator.cerita.kabar.wesel_tertangkap: The note forger was caught! Madam Qian says every old note must be re-stamped.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_tawar.kenapa: Because he is weak. The weak always have reasons, and reasons make no one strong.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_tawar.mulai: An inner disciple ran away with the Cloudstep Manual, a book he is not yet fit to read. He was seen at a road post. Bring the manual back. The disciple... is heaven's business.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_temu.alasan: My elder made us train under the waterfall until we fainted. Two of my brothers never woke. This manual is my only way to grow strong without him.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_temu.alasan.1: Give me the manual. I will speak to your elder.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_temu.mulai: Stay back! ...Are you from the sect? If you want the manual, take it. But first hear why I ran.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_temu.pergi: Thank you! I will not forget. When I am strong, I will find you!
kultivator.cerita.kabur_temu.serah: ...You promise to speak to him? ...Fine. Here. I will just go home to my village.
kultivator.cerita.kabur_tetua_balas.mula: You say he ran because of the waterfall? ...Perhaps I was too harsh. Perhaps. Do not tell the other disciples I said so.
kultivator.cerita.kafilah_siap.mulai: You are still alive! Good, good. Quickly now, before they bring friends. Stay close to me, yes?
kultivator.cerita.kafilah_tawar.jalan: There they are! Bandits! I will hide behind the cart, you... you do whatever cultivators do!
kultivator.cerita.kafilah_tawar.mulai: This is my last caravan of the season. The road to town is full of bandits, and my guard ran off yesterday. Escort me to town, and half my profit is yours. A third. A quarter, final.
kultivator.cerita.kafilah_tawar.tawar: Half? You want me to eat the wind? ...A quarter and a pouch of mountain salt. Mountain salt, sir! That is almost gold.
kultivator.cerita.kakek_lumpur_sapa.ding: Cold is only a wind that has not met us yet. I have known it sixty years.
kultivator.cerita.kakek_lumpur_sapa.lapa: Hunger is a teacher. But buns are teachers too. If you have one Spirit Value, I would like to learn from a bun.
kultivator.cerita.kakek_lumpur_sapa.teri: Hm. Your hand is warm. Someone who gives to a beggar without looking who is watching... very rare.
kultivator.cerita.kakek_lumpur_terungkap: Just one thing: the strongest power is the one that never needs using. Now go; I want to sleep.
Do not call me Elder. I retired from being somebody long ago. ...That child, Dou, is learning to write now. That matters more than any throne.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_bijak.lore: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_bijak.mula: Sit, traveller. A long road is best talked about sitting down.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_bijak.topi: This village is like rice: grow too tall and the wind breaks you. We grow low and bear much grain.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_curiga.lor: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_curiga.mul: An outsider. Hm. State your business, and do not linger near the granary.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_curiga.top: Fine until strangers come. Last year a "cultivator" walked off with three of our buffalo.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_jujur.lore: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_jujur.mula: Greetings. I have little to offer, but what there is, you may see.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_jujur.topi: Hard in the dry season, easy in the rains. We are not rich, but we owe no one.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_licik.lore: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_licik.mula: Ah, honoured guest! You must be tired. Shall I show you my cousin's inn? A discount for friends.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_licik.topi: Life? Smooth, smooth. Especially for those who know whom to smile at.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_penakut.lo: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_penakut.mu: O-oh! A guest. A cultivator guest. We have done nothing wrong, truly!
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_penakut.to: Quiet. Very quiet. Except on nights when the wolves sing. And when a sect passes. And when it storms.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_ramah.lore: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_ramah.mula: Welcome, welcome! Our village is small, but the tea is warm and the rice is never cold.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_ramah.topi: This year's harvest is enough, the children are healthy, and the well has never run dry. Heaven still loves us.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_serakah.lo: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_serakah.mu: A guest! A guest carrying spirit stones, I hope? Our lodging is cheap. Almost cheap.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_serakah.to: Life here is costly, sir. Salt is dear, iron is dear, and the sect's levy never falls. Donations are always welcome.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_sombong.lo: For three generations we have sold rice and firewood to %s. When they are kind, their disciples drive the beasts from our fields. When they are not, we light incense and hope.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_sombong.mu: You are standing in the oldest village in this valley. Take off your shoes when you enter the hall.
How is life in this village?
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_sombong.to: Other villages copy the way we plant. None of them copy it well.
Who are your neighbours in the mountains?
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_takut.lega: ...You mean it? Heavens, there are still strong people with hearts. Our craftsmen are at the village hall.
kultivator.cerita.kepala_desa_takut.mula: P-please forgive us... we will repair it ourselves. You need not trouble yourself, truly, no need!
Stand up. I will pay for the damage.
kultivator.cerita.kuli_sapa.berat: My shoulders know the answer. But look, everything that enters this city passes over our shoulders. The elders' pills, the ministers' silk, even the Thousand Blades' swords. We carry this city, one sack at a time.
kultivator.cerita.kuli_sapa.mulai: Heave! ...One sack of spirit rice, forty jin. If you cultivators want to lift one with your little finger, not in front of my foreman. He will expect every porter to do it.
kultivator.cerita.lao_qiao_sapa.jalan: The stone-paved Imperial Road, always. Forest dirt tracks are for people who enjoy being robbed. Follow the milestones; each one gives the distance in li, and the old road kings who carved them never lied.
kultivator.cerita.lao_qiao_sapa.mulai: Rare goods, carried all the way from distant towns! Silver needles, mountain salt, maps only slightly wrong!
kultivator.cerita.lao_qiao_sapa.peta: A little. The rivers are right, the mountains are right, the villages sometimes move. Villages are alive, sir; maps are not.
kultivator.cerita.lao_shi_sapa.curang: A cheating banker does not live long in the capital. I hate swindlers more than I love money, and I love money very much.
kultivator.cerita.lao_shi_sapa.mata: Cutting a cursed stone twenty years ago. The stone looked at me longer than I looked at it. Since then I know: some stones are better left closed.
kultivator.cerita.lao_shi_sapa.mulai: Raw stone, sir? Inside could be jade, or just stone. Heaven or earth, that is your own fate.
kultivator.cerita.lao_shi_sapa.mulai.1: How did you lose your eye?
kultivator.cerita.lin_fei_sapa.daftar: The city's hundred finest young cultivators, recorded by the guild. Those on top get good missions and many enemies. The boy Feng Ao is climbing with his elbows.
kultivator.cerita.lin_fei_sapa.lengan: The Beast Tide twenty years ago. A bone tiger bit it on the east wall. I bit back. It died, I lived. You count who won.
kultivator.cerita.lin_fei_sapa.mulai: Want a mission? The board is over there. Want a story? Buy my drink first.
kultivator.cerita.lin_fei_sapa.mulai.2: What is the Young Dragon List?
kultivator.cerita.lonceng_tawar.mulai: Listen to that bell. Since last month's small quake it sounds like an old man's cough. We need bronze to mend it, and bronze needs copper.
kultivator.cerita.lonceng_tawar.penting: A bell does not call the gods. A bell calls people who forgot to stop. A city without a bell is a city that never rests.
kultivator.cerita.ma_laoliu_sapa.asal: From breeders I know, or from mothers who leave their young with me. Never from a poacher's snare. If you ever bought from them, do not buy from me again.
kultivator.cerita.ma_laoliu_sapa.mulai: This one is a spirit wolf born under a full moon. Don't touch yet, let it smell your hand.
kultivator.cerita.ma_laoliu_sapa.mulai.1: How do you get these beasts?
kultivator.cerita.ma_laoliu_sapa.setia: The one you feed yourself, every morning, without fail. Not the breed; your habit.
kultivator.cerita.mo_ying_lenyap_a.mulai: Still looking for me? I am only a shadow that forgot to leave...
kultivator.cerita.mo_ying_lenyap_b.mulai: Still looking for me? I am only a shadow that forgot to leave...
kultivator.cerita.mo_ying_sapa.dingin: Poor circulation since childhood, sir. Thank you for noticing. I shall... remember your kindness.
kultivator.cerita.mo_ying_sapa.lama: Three years, seven months, eleven days. I like numbers; numbers never ask where one comes from.
kultivator.cerita.mo_ying_sapa.mulai: Welcome, honoured guest. The Minister is busy; whatever your business, I shall note it. With pleasure.
kultivator.cerita.mo_ying_sapa.mulai.1: Have you served Minister Gu long?
kultivator.cerita.murid_dalam_sapa.mulai: You are the Elder's guest? The way to the main hall is up those stone steps. Do not stray into the scripture pavilion; its keeper has no sense of humour.
kultivator.cerita.murid_dalam_sapa.tandi: A spar? With a guest? ...One round. If the Elder asks, we were "exchanging insights".
kultivator.cerita.murid_klan_sapa.hidup: Up before the rooster, train, breakfast, train, field work, train. If lucky, chosen for a sect trial. If not, marry and teach your children to stand like a horse.
kultivator.cerita.murid_klan_sapa.latih: Granary Guardian Tiger Fist. A grand name, but its first form is just standing in a horse stance for one stick of incense. I have been on the first form for three years.
kultivator.cerita.murid_klan_sapa.mulai: You are an outsider, right? Do not cross the training yard when the young master is there. He likes to "test" guests. The test usually ends with the guest in the pond.
kultivator.cerita.murid_luar_sapa.hidup: Sweeping, carrying water, breathing drills, sweeping again. Work hard for three years and maybe you become an inner disciple. If not, well, more sweeping.
kultivator.cerita.murid_luar_sapa.mulai: What brings you to our sect? The elder is meditating; if it is urgent, I can call a senior brother.
What is an outer disciple's life like?
kultivator.cerita.naga_muda_arena.mulai: So you are the one who beat me on the mission board. Arena. Now. No sharp blades, no killing arts.
kultivator.cerita.naga_muda_sikap.dendam: Laugh while you can. The road is long, and I remember every face.
kultivator.cerita.naga_muda_sikap.mulai: ...You won. Happy? The crowd is waiting for you to do something.
(Offer your hand) You were a good opponent.
kultivator.cerita.naga_muda_sikap.sahaba: Hmph. ...You are buying the drinks. No, I am. I refuse to owe you anything.
kultivator.cerita.naga_muda_tawar.mulai: Want onto the Young Dragon List? There is a condition: you must get past Feng Ao. The boy climbs with his elbows, but his elbows are sharp.
kultivator.cerita.naga_muda_tawar.mulai_: Take a mission from the board. Whoever finishes first wins the first round. Feng Ao has read that board three times this morning.
kultivator.cerita.nelayan_sapa.cuaca: Herons flying low, ants climbing the posts. Rain before noon. Fishermen need no watch tower; we have herons.
kultivator.cerita.nelayan_sapa.ikan_roh: Once, a gold-scaled carp as long as my arm. It looked at me and I looked at it. Then I let it go. My wife is still angry, but since then my net has never come up empty.
kultivator.cerita.nelayan_sapa.mulai: Shh, not so loud. The fish here have ears, and they do not like cultivators. Too many fish with lightning.
kultivator.cerita.ou_ye_sapa.leluhur: Of his students' line. The name is too big for this hammer. I still forge to deserve it.
kultivator.cerita.ou_ye_sapa.mulai: Good iron waits for good fire.
kultivator.cerita.ou_ye_sapa.mulai.1: Are you of the famous Ou Ye line?
kultivator.cerita.ou_ye_sapa.pedang: One that knows who holds it.
kultivator.cerita.pandai_desa_sapa.cangk: Ah, that. A cultivator stayed here last year and left a piece of cold iron as payment. I mixed it into a hoe. Now the hoe splits stone and the farmer split his own foot. Twice.
kultivator.cerita.pandai_desa_sapa.mulai: The heat is right, the iron cherry-red. Do not stand there; the sparks like to jump onto strangers' trousers.
Is it true you made a hoe that cuts stone?
kultivator.cerita.pandai_desa_sapa.pedan: Swords? Swords are for people who want to fight. Hoes are for people who want to eat. In this village more want to eat. But if a sect orders, yes, I can. My hands remember.
kultivator.cerita.panen_tawar.mulai: Traveller, rest a while in our village. ...But look at those fields: the rice leaves yellow before their time. The elders say our water has lost its spirit, or beasts from the den in the woods trample the channels.
kultivator.cerita.panen_tawar.mulai.2: I will drive off the beasts.
kultivator.cerita.panen_tawar.terima: Heaven sent you! We do not have much, but our granary is open to you.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_hormat.aula: Every tablet there is someone who chose the clan over themselves. One day there may be a small tablet for the guest who taught my son how to fall.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_hormat.mulai: My son fell before the whole clan and rose wiser. That is a debt I cannot pay in silver. The clan's land is open to you, and so is the ancestral hall.
Tell me about the ancestral hall.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_bijak.lo: Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_bijak.mu: Your steps are calm. Those who walk calmly on another's land usually carry good intent.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_bijak.to: A clan is not blood. A clan is the same table every night. Blood is only the reason to sit at it.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_curiga.l: Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_curiga.m: What business brings you to my clan's land? Answer plainly; spies speak in circles.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_curiga.t: This clan has lasted two hundred years because we do not trust easily. Do not be offended.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_jujur.lo: Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_jujur.mu: Greetings. Our clan is simple, and I say things as they are. What do you seek?
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_jujur.to: We were once great, then small, and now we are growing again. Like bamboo after the cut.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_licik.lo: Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_licik.mu: A guest! What luck. Our clan is looking for strong friends. Friends, not servants, of course.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_licik.to: This clan always sides with the winner. As it happens, we always know who will win.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
W-which sect are you from? We pay our tribute on time, ask them yourself!
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
Our clan is small and seeks no trouble. When trouble comes, we usually... close the doors.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_ramah.lo: Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_ramah.mu: A guest on clan land is a guest of the ancestors. Come in, drink tea with us.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_klan_ramah.to: We are a large family: smiths, farmers and a few cultivators. The strong protect the weak; the weak feed the strong.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
A strong outsider. Strength always has a price on this land, and prices can always be negotiated.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
The small mine on that hill is ours. It yields enough... for now. If you know of another mine, tell me.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
Every tablet in that hall is someone who chose the clan over themselves. We clean them every morning so no one forgets the price of a family name. %s once tried to buy this land; those tablets were our answer.
You stand on the land of a clan that bore three Golden Core elders. Lower your head a little.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
Our ancestor slew a wolf king with a single stroke. The painting hangs in the hall; feel free to envy it.
What does the ancestral hall mean to you?
kultivator.cerita.patriark_remeh.lagi: Oh? Interesting. He is in the training yard. If you win this time, I will forget that day ever happened.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_remeh.mulai: Ah, the one who yielded to my son. Prices here are a little higher for those who do not stand tall. Do not be offended; it is tradition.
kultivator.cerita.patriark_remeh.mulai.1: I want to challenge your son again.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_ayah_ou_ye.baru: Hmm. Melt, reforge, carve the name. A blade born twice. Six iron ingots.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_ayah_ou_ye.lama: Good. An honest scar is stronger than steel that lies. Six iron ingots.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_ayah_ou_ye.mula: ...A guard's sword. Village steel, honest work. It broke on a spirit beast's bone, not because the steel was poor.
Join it as it was; let the scar show.
Forge it into a new blade.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_ayah_tunggu.mul: Not yet. Steel cannot be hurried. Tomorrow.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_selesai.mulai: A sword named too soon breaks too soon. Wait until it has saved your life once.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_tawar.mulai: You. Your hand holds a hilt correctly. Rare.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_tawar.usul: I want to forge one nameless sword. Not for sale. For its owner. It needs a Spirit Vein Crystal, eight iron, and your hand on the tongs.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_tempa.irama: One. Two. Not so hard; the iron is not your enemy. ...Now take it to a spirit spring while it is still red. Hurry.
kultivator.cerita.pedang_tempa.mulai.1: (Take the tongs and follow the rhythm of his hammer)
kultivator.cerita.pedang_tempa.mulai.1.a: You need a Spirit Vein Crystal and eight iron ingots.
kultivator.cerita.pelayan_sapa.laris: Meat buns in the morning, pulled noodles at noon, and gossip all day. The last is free, but sells out fastest.
kultivator.cerita.pelayan_sapa.mulai: Please sit! Green tea, flower tea, or "Bibi Hong says this one is best" tea? The last is the same as the first, but dearer.
kultivator.cerita.pelayan_sapa.mulai.2: What news have you heard from guests?
kultivator.cerita.pelayan_sekte_sapa.lam: Twenty years. I have watched disciples arrive as snotty children and leave as elders. They all forget my name. That is fine; I remember theirs, and their favourite tea.
kultivator.cerita.pelayan_sekte_sapa.mul: A guest? Please, please. The tea is freshly brewed, and do not sit on the blue cushion; it belongs to the Third Elder and he can smell where people have sat.
Have you served this sect long?
What do the disciples talk about?
Tell me about this sect's founder.
kultivator.cerita.pelayan_sekte_sapa.pen: That painting in the main hall is the founder. The disciples say he split a mountain with one stroke. I dust the painting every month; to me he looks like someone who liked afternoon naps.
kultivator.cerita.pemotong_sapa.aneh: Once, a stone as big as a buffalo's head. Empty inside, except for a tiny frog, still alive. Lao Shi put it in the back pond. That frog is thirty years old now and has never made a sound.
kultivator.cerita.pemotong_sapa.giok: The skin tells a story. A thin waxy band means jade may be near; root-like cracks mean water once passed; a stone that feels too light usually lies. Still, half of it is guessing. That is why they call it gambling.
kultivator.cerita.pemotong_sapa.mulai: Want a cut? Choose your stone, pay Lao Shi, then pray for me. My hands are steady, but a man's luck lives inside the stone.
kultivator.cerita.pemotong_sapa.mulai.1: How do you know there is jade inside?
kultivator.cerita.penceramah_sapa.cendek: The Grand Library keeps a copy of the basic manual of every sect that swore the oath. Anyone may read the first page; nobody may read the last. That is neutrality: all know the beginning, none owns the end.
kultivator.cerita.penceramah_sapa.fana: Because cultivators live too long to remember small things. The price of rice in the flood year, the name of the builder of the bridge, the song sung at funerals. Mortals remember small things. Small things are history.
kultivator.cerita.penceramah_sapa.mulai: Ah, a listener! Sit. Today's lecture: why this city has no emperor. The short answer is seven. The long answer is three hours.
Tell me about the Scholars' District.
Why does a mortal teach in a cultivators' city?
kultivator.cerita.penceramah_sapa.singka: Seven sects, seven broken swords, one oath. No sect would let another become emperor, so they chose a warden. A warden can be replaced; an emperor usually can only be killed. That is progress, if you ask me.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_hormat.mulai: (The guard raises his spear upright and salutes.) The one who saved our comrade's father's sword. Our barracks always has tea for you.
This is my father's sword. He stood on the wall during the great Beast Tide twenty years ago, beside Guildmaster Lin Fei when she still had two arms. The sword broke; my father did not come home. The day of remembrance is near.
I will take it to Ou Ye.
Visitor, wait. Do you... do you know Young Ou Ye at the forge guild? They say he will not take orders from a mere guard.
Thank you. It is wrapped in red cloth; do not open it on the road. The blade is still sharp, and my father did not like careless people.
Of course. I am only a guard; my duty is the gate, not troubling guests.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_penguasa_gu.m: Minister Gu, I mean Prince Gu, added watches and raised our pay. We are richer and more tired. The Black Market is raided every week; I have never been this busy.
I hope you get some sleep.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_penguasa_ruyi: Since Lady Ruyi took the throne, palace guards are told to greet the people. I am not used to it yet. ...Good morning? Afternoon? Good, anyway.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.audiensi: Your Good Name in this city must be high enough, or you must bring something that makes the Minister curious. And do not come at lunch; the Prince feeds the koi himself.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.mulai: This road leads to the Warden's Palace. Visitors may pass as far as the archway; beyond that you need a summons.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.mulai.1: How does one get an audience?
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.mulai.3: Have you ever seen the Prince smile?
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.pangeran: ...Once. When little Lady Ruyi fell into the koi pond and came out holding the biggest fish. Do not say I told you.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.pedang: You changed your mind? I still keep the sword in the barracks.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.pedang.1: Yes. I will take it to Ou Ye.
kultivator.cerita.pengawal_sapa.sejarah: Once this was the fortress of seven sects. Look at the west wall: the stones are a different colour. That was the hall of a sect that no longer exists. We are not allowed to say its name.
kultivator.cerita.penjual_senjata_sapa.k: That is "Rain Cutter". My grandfather swore it once split the rain so its owner stayed dry. We never sell it; we have also never tested it in the rain.
kultivator.cerita.penjual_senjata_sapa.m: The Thousand Blades Pavilion! Jian, dao, spears, iron fans. Hold one first, feel the weight. A good blade feels like an old memory in the palm.
What is that rusty sword in the case?
kultivator.cerita.penjual_senjata_sapa.s: Your feet are still light, your qi not yet deep. A slender jian for you: quick out, quick back. Great blades are for those who already know how to fall.
Ah, one like you needs a weapon that will not shatter when your qi pours in full. Look at the top rack; the spirit-grade ones. The price is high too, but your head is worth more.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_bijak.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_bijak.mulai: Sit. You did not come here by chance; nobody comes here by chance.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_bijak.topik: Nothing. Seeking is a late way of finding.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_curiga.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_curiga.mulai: Who told you the way to this cave?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_curiga.topik: Stillness. And you are disturbing it.
You have fewer than eight Spirit Grass.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_herba.mulai.3: I have not found one yet.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_herba.terima: Its roots remember a hundred winters. Good. Now sit in that chamber, and let the incense speak.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_jujur.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_jujur.mulai: I have little to teach, but much time to listen.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_jujur.topik: An answer to my own mistakes. In town I was right too often.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.benar: ...Hm. That is not an answer. That is understanding. Sit with me once more, for the last time.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k0: A traveller carries a lantern at high noon. Why?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k0.1: So he never forgets that night always comes.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k1: The mountain never moves, yet the clouds always pass it. Which is stronger?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k1.1: The mountain, because it is still.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k1.2: The question moves, not either of them.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k1.3: The clouds, because they are free.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k10: Your shadow follows you everywhere. How do you lose it?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k10.2: Sit under a tree when the sun is straight overhead.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k11: A master taught nothing for three years. His student became wise. What did he teach?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k11.3: That answers do not come from other people's mouths.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k2: You pour tea into a cup that is already full. What spills?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k2.3: Whatever you refuse to let go of.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k3: The finest sword is never drawn. Then why was it forged?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k3.1: So the hand that holds it learns restraint.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k4: The river flows to the sea without knowing the way. How does it never get lost?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k4.2: It always chooses the lower place.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k4.3: It is lost, but does not care.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k5: A disciple sweeps the yard every morning, and every evening leaves fall again. Has he failed?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k5.1: Yes, he should cut the tree down.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k5.2: Yes, his work is in vain.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k5.3: The yard was never his task; the sweeping was.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k6: Fire burns the wood away, then dies. Where did the fire go?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k6.1: Into the warmth of those who sat beside it.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k6.2: Up to the sky with the smoke.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k7: A bird lives in a golden cage and sings every day. Is it happy?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k7.2: Ask the cage door, not the song.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k8: Two monks watch a flag flutter. One says the flag moves, the other says the wind. Who is right?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k8.1: The one who says the wind.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k8.2: The one who says the flag.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k8.3: It is their hearts that move.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k9: If you meet the Dao on the road, what do you do?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k9.1: Keep walking beside it without greeting it.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.k9.3: Catch it so it cannot run.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.mulai: Listen well. Do not answer with your head.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_koan.salah: You answered with your head. Go home, sleep, and return when your head is lighter.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_licik.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_licik.mulai: Visitors to a hermit's cave usually want something. What can you trade?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_licik.topik: Secrets. And I have many. Want to buy one?
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_lulus.mulai: Why come back? This cave is no longer mine. Sit if you wish; the spring asks nothing in return.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_penakut.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_penakut.mulai: You are not a robber? Good. I am too old to run.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_penakut.topik: A place where nobody looks for me. It worked so far, except today.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_ramah.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_ramah.mulai: Ah, a visitor. The water here is fresh; drink before you speak.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_ramah.topik: A voice that is not noise. In town everyone speaks at once.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_serakah.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_serakah.mulai: Did you bring anything sweet? Hermits have tongues too.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_serakah.topik: Freedom from desire. I am still looking. Meanwhile, I want honey.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_sombong.lore: Before me, an old woman who taught the birds to sing. Before her, a bear. Before the bear, water. A cave is never owned; it is only lent.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_sombong.mulai: You are fortunate. I receive no visitor without a bond, and it seems you have one.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_sombong.topik: The Dao. The others on this mountain seek herbs.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_tawar.mulai: You who share a bond with me, sit.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_tawar.sepi: Because in town I was heard too often, and listened too rarely.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_tawar.sepi.1: I am ready for your trials.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_tawar.ujian: Three trials. Bring a herb older than you. Sit without moving for as long as the incense burns. Then answer one question that has no answer.
kultivator.cerita.pertapa_tawar.ujian.2: Why do you live alone here?
kultivator.cerita.pesan.calon: The child waits at your sect hall as a candidate. Accept them on the next Gate Opening Day.
kultivator.cerita.pesan.calon_kabur: The runaway disciple will knock at your sect gate one day.
kultivator.cerita.petani_sapa.mulai: Good day, sir. The soil is moist, the worms are fat. A sign of a good harvest, if the locusts are not pleased too.
kultivator.cerita.petani_sapa.mulai.2: Is it hard living near a sect?
kultivator.cerita.petani_sapa.sekte: There are gains: wild beasts fear to come near. There are losses: sometimes the sky explodes over the mountain and our hens stop laying for a week.
kultivator.cerita.petani_sapa.tanam: Rice in the lower paddies, yams on the slope, and a little patch of spirit herbs behind the house the tax collector must not know about. ...You did not hear that last part.
kultivator.cerita.pilihan.terkunci: Not yet: the condition is not met.
kultivator.cerita.qian_duoduo_sapa.lama: Older than the city. House Qian counted stones before the seven sects made peace. Wars come and go; interest keeps running.
kultivator.cerita.qian_duoduo_sapa.mulai: Welcome to the money house. Your spirit stones are safe with us. Depositing, withdrawing, or just counting your wealth?
kultivator.cerita.qian_duoduo_sapa.wesel: A paper worth as many stones as you deposited, cashable at the money house of any capital. Lighter than stone and harder to steal, as long as you never accept a note from a stranger.
kultivator.cerita.quest.anak_berbakat.au: Escort the child to your sect hall.
kultivator.cerita.quest.anak_berbakat.ha: The child stood at your hall gate wide-eyed, hugging a small bundle. On the next Gate Opening Day, they will be the first candidate to knock.
Their mother called them home before the journey was done. The village well still ripples whenever they pass.
The sect elder touched the child's brow and was silent a long time. "A pure water spirit root," he said. The sect remembers your name well.
kultivator.cerita.quest.anak_berbakat.je: Speak to the child and ask them to come.
kultivator.cerita.quest.anak_berbakat.ri: A village child can make the well water ripple just by looking at it. Take them where they can be taught.
kultivator.cerita.quest.anak_berbakat.se: Escort the child to the nearest sect compound.
kultivator.cerita.quest.batu_bermata_dar: Lao Shi touched his eyepatch and laughed softly. "Twenty years I waited for someone who could put a stone to sleep. If you ever cut stone here, I will choose it for you myself."
Bring the Blood-Eyed Stone to Monk Jing Xin at the city temple.
Tell Lao Shi the stone has gone to sleep.
A cursed raw stone drains whoever cuts it. Take it to the temple before it devours someone.
Gaze into the stone's eye with Monk Jing Xin.
The kit leapt into Ma Laoliu's arms and bit his beard. Ma Laoliu laughed until he cried and gave you a friend's price at his stall.
Track the poachers to the nearest bandit camp by the road.
Bring the fox kit home to Ma Laoliu.
Defeat the bandits at the camp and take back the fox kit.
A silver spirit fox kit was stolen from Ma Laoliu's pens by poachers. The trail leads to the road and the smell of campfire.
kultivator.cerita.quest.daftar_naga_muda: Challenge Feng Ao in the arena and beat him in a duel.
Feng Ao slaps your hand away.
Your name entered the Young Dragon List. Feng Ao left the arena without looking back, and you know you will meet again on the road.
Your name entered the Young Dragon List, just above Feng Ao. He grumbled, then bought you noodles. The best rival is the one who makes you better.
Finish one mission from the Cultivators' Guild board before Feng Ao takes it.
To enter the Young Dragon List you must get past Feng Ao. Three times: on the mission board, in the arena, and after.
Feng Ao lies in the arena sand. Speak to him.
kultivator.cerita.quest.demam_kumuh.bawa: Take the medicine to the slums and speak with Little Dou, who knows which houses are sick.
kultivator.cerita.quest.demam_kumuh.grat: You hand out the medicine for free.
kultivator.cerita.quest.demam_kumuh.hasi: Dou leads you from hut to hut. In the last one an old woman holds your hand and will not let go until she falls asleep. Three days later the fever breaks across the slums, and the slum children start calling you "Sky Healer", though you are no healer.

The slum folk scrape together chip after chip. The fever breaks, but Dou no longer runs to greet you. "The medicine works," he says quietly. "It is just dear for us." Grandpa Mud only watches you a long while from his pile of straw.
kultivator.cerita.quest.demam_kumuh.raci: Refine any pill at any furnace; the healer will blend it into fever medicine.
kultivator.cerita.quest.demam_kumuh.ring: A red fever is spreading in the slums. The healer has run out of fever pills, and the people there cannot pay.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.air: Fetch Spirit Water from a spirit spring for the fields.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.hasi: A week later the rice was green again. The village held a small feast and gave you the seat of honour. The village head whispered: "If you wish it, this village will pledge itself to you."
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.lapo: Tell the village head the channels are safe.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.pili: You decide how to help the village.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.ring: The village rice yellows before its time. Spirit water, or the beasts that trample the channels from their den in the woods?
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.sara: Go to the nearest Beast Den in the woods.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.sira: Bring the Spirit Water to the village head.
kultivator.cerita.quest.gagal_panen.usir: Drive off the savage beasts around the den.
kultivator.cerita.quest.kafilah_terakhir: Bandits block the way! Defeat them.
The caravan scattered on the road. Lao Qiao survived; his goods did not. "Next season," he said, "there is always a next season."
Lao Qiao sold his goods in one afternoon and shared the profit with you: a quarter, as promised, plus a pouch of mountain salt "for luck".
Escort Lao Qiao to the nearest town.
Lao Qiao's last caravan of the season must reach town, and the road is plagued by bandits.
Speak to Lao Qiao and continue the journey.
The array keeper teaches you to read the trigram carvings.

While tuning the crystal, the array keeper shows how the eight trigrams on the stone disc answer one another like a conversation. "An array is not magic," he says. "An array is a promise carved so deep that even heaven is ashamed to break it." You go home with a head full of lines and directions.
The new crystal hums, then glows a pale violet. The array keeper counts spirit stone chips into your palm one by one, then counts them again. "Arrays and money," he says, "both must be exact."
Bring eight amethyst shards to the array keeper.
Help the array keeper set the new crystal.
One of the four crystal pillars of the teleport station has cracked. The array keeper needs fresh amethyst before the crack spreads.
The array keeper pays for your help.
kultivator.cerita.quest.lonceng_retak.de: Hear the first toll of the mended bell.
kultivator.cerita.quest.lonceng_retak.ha: The first toll rolled over the city roofs. The children stopped playing to listen, and Grandpa Mud, for once, opened his eyes.
kultivator.cerita.quest.lonceng_retak.pe: Bring sixteen copper ingots to Monk Jing Xin.
kultivator.cerita.quest.lonceng_retak.ri: The temple bell cracked after a small quake. Bring copper for its bronze and wait for the craftsmen to cast it.
kultivator.cerita.quest.lonceng_retak.tu: The craftsmen cast the bronze overnight. Wait until tomorrow.
kultivator.cerita.quest.murid_kabur.cari: Find the runaway at the nearest road post.
kultivator.cerita.quest.murid_kabur.hasi: The elder took his manual back. When you mentioned the waterfall he fell silent, and that week no disciple trained until they fainted.
The disciple vanished down the road with his manual. The sect remembers your face coldly, but someone out there owes you a life.
kultivator.cerita.quest.murid_kabur.kemb: Return the stolen manual to the sect elder.
kultivator.cerita.quest.murid_kabur.ring: An inner disciple ran away with a sect manual. He was seen at a road post. The manual, or the disciple?
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_ayah.besi: Ou Ye asks for six iron ingots to join the blade.
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_ayah.empu: Take the broken sword to Young Ou Ye at the Forge Guild.
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_ayah.hasi: Ou Ye melted the pieces and forged a new blade, with the father's name carved near the hilt. The guard drew it once, then sheathed it with trembling hands. "Now he will stand watch beside me." The palace guards salute whenever you pass.

The blade was joined without hiding the break: a thin silver line across the old steel. The guard looked at it a long time, then gave a short laugh. "Father always said a hidden wound never heals." From that day the palace guards salute whenever you pass.
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_ayah.ring: A palace guard keeps his father's broken sword; his father fell holding back the great Beast Tide twenty years ago. He wants it whole again before the day of remembrance.
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_ayah.sera: Collect the sword from Ou Ye and give it to the guard.
Collect the sword from Ou Ye and give it to the guard.
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_ayah.tung: Ou Ye works through the night. Come back tomorrow.
kultivator.cerita.quest.pedang_tanpa_nam: Quench the glowing blade in a spirit spring.
Ou Ye looked at the blade for a long time, then said one sentence: "Its name will come on its own." Carve its name whenever you are ready.
Take a Spirit Vein Crystal from a Spirit Vein Cave.
Young Ou Ye wants to forge one sword that is not for sale: for its owner alone. Vein crystal, iron, fire and spirit water.
Bring the crystal and eight iron ingots to Young Ou Ye, then forge with him.
kultivator.cerita.quest.peta_awan.bayar: Return to Captain Yun Fei for your pay.
Yun Fei paid you and swore the crate held "only love letters and mooncakes". Your next cloud voyage is free.
kultivator.cerita.quest.peta_awan.kota: Deliver the Cloud Cargo to a cultivator town.
kultivator.cerita.quest.peta_awan.langit: Deliver the Cloud Cargo to a sect's sky palace.
kultivator.cerita.quest.peta_awan.muat: The Cloud Cargo is yours to carry.
kultivator.cerita.quest.peta_awan.ringka: Captain Yun Fei needs a courier for his sealed crate, to a sect's sky palace or another cultivator town. Do not open it.
kultivator.cerita.quest.resep_hilang.has: The guild copied the page into its master book. Your name is in the footnote, in very neat small letters.
You kept the Nine Dews Formula for yourself. Dan Chen said nothing, and his silence was colder than winter.
kultivator.cerita.quest.resep_hilang.mak: Find the Ancient Recipe Page in the nearest inheritance tomb.
kultivator.cerita.quest.resep_hilang.pil: The page is in your hands. Take it to Elder Dan Chen and decide.
kultivator.cerita.quest.resep_hilang.rin: The last page of the Nine Dews Formula was left in an inheritance tomb. Give it to the guild, or keep it?
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.bal: Ah Lun is writing a reply. Speak to him again.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.car: Look for Ah Lun at the nearest sect compound.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.has: Ah Lun came home to his mother's inn and now helps as a server. Bibi Hong calls you "my second child" every time you visit.
Bibi Hong read the letter three times, cried twice and laughed once. Your room and meals at the inn are free for seven days.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.kab: Ah Lun is free. Tell Bibi Hong.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.pul: Bring Ah Lun's reply to Bibi Hong.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.rin: Bibi Hong's son Ah Lun joined a sect three seasons ago and has never written.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.tah: The demonic sect will not release its disciple. Beat its elder in a duel, or pay a ransom.
kultivator.cerita.quest.surat_ah_lun.tem: Ask the outer disciples about Ah Lun and hand him his mother's letter.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_dua_calon: Prince Yan Wushuang summons you to the Palace Hall.
Win the backing of three of the five city heads: Elder Dan Chen, Lin Fei, Madam Qian, Young Ou Ye, Magistrate Bao.
Three city heads stand behind Gu Lianshan.
The guild council recorded its backing for Gu Lianshan. The merchants hung lanterns before their shops; Ruyi closed the door of her room.
You took no side. The city is split in two, and the council delays its choice until the truth speaks louder.
The guild council recorded its backing for Yan Ruyi. In the palace corridor, Gu Lianshan smiled and offered his congratulations before anyone else.
Prince Yan wishes to withdraw. Ruyi or Gu Lianshan? The guild council listens to those the people trust.
Three city heads stand behind Ruyi.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_hilang_di: Open the cells in the demon lair and free the captives.
The missing were never found. The slums lock their doors earlier now, and Dou no longer laughs under the bridge.
The captives came home to the slums. On Magistrate Bao's desk lies the Shadow Seal: an upturned lotus, sign of the demonic path, found inside a city sworn to let its swords sleep.
Bring the Shadow Seal left in the lair to Magistrate Bao.
Find three clues in the slums: Little Dou, Grandpa Mud, and a beggar who saw something.
Children are vanishing from the slums. Gather three clues and follow the trail to the lair that holds them.
The cart tracks and the black talisman point out of the city. Find the nearest Demonic Cultivator Lair.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_kedatanga: Speak with Captain Tie Hu at the capital gate.
Magistrate Bao wrote your name among those willing to help. For the first time, the city knows you.
Since people began to vanish, Tie Hu writes down every face at the gate. Magistrate Bao has posted a notice at the Yamen.
Find Magistrate Bao Qing at the Yamen and read his notice.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_malam_ger: Defeat two demonic elders who slipped into the capital.
Dawn came red, then amber, then ordinary. The guards counted the survivors, and for the first time Tie Hu did not count alone.
The guards held until dawn, at great cost. Tie Hu does not blame you; he simply does not say your name.
The sky turns red. Mo Ying's disciples strike from the shadows alongside a beast tide. Defend the capital.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_penobatan: Come to the capital for the coronation.
Prince Yan pinned the Palace Badge to your chest before the whole city. The palace doors now open to you without question.
You stood among the crowd. Nobody spoke your name, and perhaps that was for the best.
Lanterns are lit at noon. The whole city gathers to see who takes the throne.
Prince Yan does not look your way.
Watch Prince Yan Wushuang hand over the city in the Grand Square.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_pewaris_s: Draw Spirit Spring Water at a spirit spring.
Bring the Blood Venom Antidote Pill to Yan Ruyi in the palace.
Ruyi swallows the pill. Her breath calms, but nobody knows who made it.
The heir lives thanks to a Black Market pill. The city is grateful; Elder Dan Chen will not meet your eyes.
The palace physicians held the venom back with silver needles. Ruyi survived, but her body stays frail.
The pill you refined with honest hands saved the heir. Elder Dan Chen, for the first time, nodded to you.
Buy the antidote from a Black Market broker.
Refine one pill at any furnace with a flame that does not waver. The spirit ingredient in your bag will guide the cure.
Yan Ruyi collapsed during the rites: blood venom. Elder Dan Chen has the formula, but not the ingredients.
Ruyi swallows the pill. Colour returns to her cheeks.
Meet Elder Dan Chen at the Alchemist Guild.
Pick Starwort inside a Spirit Vein Cave.
kultivator.cerita.quest.takhta_topeng_te: Go to the Heart Mirror Cave and look into its pool, as Jing Xin asked.
Defeat Mo Ying in a duel in the Cloud District warehouse.
The proofs were never complete. Mo Ying still stands behind Minister Gu, writing figures with his cold hand.
Mo Ying fell among the salt crates. His mask split in two, and the face beneath was the same face, only without the smile. He fled, leaving his ring behind.
At the open trial in the Yamen, Mo Ying smiled until the third proof was read. Then his mask cracked, and he burst through the Yamen roof like black smoke. The city knows his name now.
You took Mo Ying's spirit stones. The proofs burned in his brazier, and his smile, that night, was wider than ever.
Ask Monk Jing Xin about the pilgrim who never burns incense.
Magistrate Bao Qing summons you to the Yamen.
The proofs are in your hands. Take them to Magistrate Bao, or face Mo Ying yourself.
Ask Madam Qian Duoduo to open the Money House ledgers.
Poison in the palace, a Shadow Seal in the slums, palace money vanishing: three threads, one knot. Gather the proofs and decide how to tear off the mask.
Magistrate Bao's gavel falls three times.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tawanan_pulang.h: A mother ran barefoot from her door. Nobody in the village asked who you were; they only poured tea and told you to sit.
You were separated on the road. May they find their own way; the sun always rises in the east.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tawanan_pulang.k: Escort the captive home to the nearest village.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tawanan_pulang.r: The captive you freed dares not walk alone. Escort them home to the nearest village.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tawanan_pulang.s: The family runs out to meet them.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tawanan_pulang.t: You are separated on the road.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tiga_ujian_perta: The hermit smiled for the first time. The next morning the cave was empty; only a mat remained, a quiet spring, and a bamboo stick carved with one word: "Still". The cave now belongs to whoever is willing to sit in it.
Bring an old herb: one Ninecurl Ginseng, or eight Spirit Grass.
Meditate in the hermit's chamber without a break for as long as the incense burns (five minutes).
A herb older than you, stillness for as long as the incense burns, and one question without an answer.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tikus_dapur.hasi: Stripes caught the spirit rat in one night. Fat Zhu named his new soup "Hero's Soup", and you eat there free for as long as he remembers, which is forever.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tikus_dapur.jaga: Keep watch in the capital after dark (21:00 to midnight).
kultivator.cerita.quest.tikus_dapur.jera: Bring four bundles of string for snares to Fat Zhu.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tikus_dapur.kemb: Bring Stripes to Fat Zhu's kitchen.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tikus_dapur.kuci: Snares are not enough. Borrow a hunting cat from Ma Laoliu at the Beast Market.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tikus_dapur.ring: A spirit rat the size of a puppy is eating Fat Zhu's spirit rice. Zhu is too afraid to enter his own storeroom.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tuan_muda_sombon: Defeat the young master in a duel before his clan.
The young master rose from the dust and bowed, stiff but sincere. That night the Patriarch invited you to drink in the ancestral hall; the clan's land is open to you.
You yielded. The young master laughed and the clan cheered. Prices in this village are a little higher for you now; the price for one who does not stand tall.
The young master falls before his clan.
The clan's young master challenges you before his whole village. Defeat him, or yield.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tungku_pertama.h: Your name is written on the Alchemist Guild board as a First Rank alchemist, in letters smaller than anyone else's.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tungku_pertama.n: Bring your work to Elder Dan Chen.
kultivator.cerita.quest.tungku_pertama.r: Refine any pill at a furnace. Do not let the flame die.
The First Alchemist Rank exam: refine one pill without burning the furnace, without crying, without asking twice.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_1.h: One stone a day. That is my whole secret, and now it is yours.
Heart Trial: stay steadfast through three illusions.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_1.k: Hear the story of Shi Ban to its end.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_1.m: Pass the Strength and Comprehension trials in the tomb chambers.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_1.p: Return to the remnant soul of Shi Ban.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_1.r: The remnant soul of Shi Ban, "The Stone Bearer", guards a tier 1 tomb of the Body Dao. Hear the story and prove you are worthy of the legacy.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_2.h: Iron bones are not born from blows. They are born from burdens you refuse to drop.
Heart Trial: stay steadfast through three illusions.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_2.k: Hear the story of Tie Gu to its end.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_2.m: Pass the Strength and Comprehension trials in the tomb chambers.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_2.p: Return to the remnant soul of Tie Gu.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_2.r: The remnant soul of Tie Gu, "Iron Bones", guards a tier 2 tomb of the Body Dao. Hear the story and prove you are worthy of the legacy.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_3.h: Be strong as a mountain, but remember: the best mountains have a path.
Heart Trial: stay steadfast through three illusions.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_3.k: Hear the story of Pan Yue to its end.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_3.m: Pass the Strength and Comprehension trials in the tomb chambers.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_3.p: Return to the remnant soul of Pan Yue.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_body_3.r: The remnant soul of Pan Yue, "The Walking Mountain", guards a tier 3 tomb of the Body Dao. Hear the story and prove you are worthy of the legacy.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_fire_1.h: The best fire is not the biggest, but the one that keeps others warm the longest.
Heart Trial: stay steadfast through three illusions.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_fire_1.k: Hear the story of Tao Hong to its end.
kultivator.cerita.quest.warisan_fire_1.m: Pass the Strength and Comprehension trials in the tomb chambers.
