kultivator.cerita.quest.wesel_palsu.hasi: The forger was tried at the Yamen. Madam Qian paid you to the last chip, then counted it again in front of you, twice.
The forged notes stopped circulating, for now. Madam Qian heard the story from someone else and struck your name in black ink.
kultivator.cerita.quest.wesel_palsu.ring: Forged money notes bearing House Qian's seal are circulating. Track the forger down to the slums.
kultivator.cerita.quest.wesel_palsu.tany: Ask Little Dou who spends money notes in the slums.
kultivator.cerita.resep_hilang_pilih.mul: You found it? Show me! ...This is my master's hand. No, my master's master. His hand did not tremble even once.
This page belongs to the guild.
kultivator.cerita.resep_hilang_pilih.ser: ...Thank you. I have not said that word since the plague year. Do not get used to hearing it.
kultivator.cerita.resep_hilang_pilih.sim: I see. The formula will live in your head and die with you. A very... private choice.
kultivator.cerita.resep_hilang_tawar.bah: Inheritance tombs test the heart, strength and understanding. Those who fail do not die; they only come home empty-handed with heads full of nightmares.
kultivator.cerita.resep_hilang_tawar.mul: There is something more important than your praise. A hundred years ago my master's master copied the Nine Dews Formula from the tomb of an ancestral alchemist. The last page was left behind. Our book has limped ever since.
kultivator.cerita.resep_hilang_tawar.pes: The ink smells of sandalwood. If you smell sandalwood in a tomb, you are close.
kultivator.cerita.rubah_tawar.kenapa: Silver spirit fox fur sells dearly on the Black Market. Kits sell for more, because they can be forced to grow with foul pills. I do not want to imagine it.
kultivator.cerita.rubah_tawar.mulai: A spirit fox kit, silver, three weeks old. Stolen from my pens last night. The lock was opened, not broken: practised hands. The boot tracks lead to the road, with the smell of campfire.
kultivator.cerita.rubah_tawar.pesan: She likes to be touched behind the ears. If she bites, it means she loves you.
kultivator.cerita.ruyi_berkuasa.mulai: I have opened the granaries. Gu Lianshan, it turns out, still works at the treasury: he counts, I decide. The city walks on two legs now, and neither leg is frail.
kultivator.cerita.ruyi_dipimpin_gu.mulai: I lost. But I can still open a public kitchen at the temple every third day; Monk Jing Xin lent me his largest pot. The throne is not the only key to the granary after all.
kultivator.cerita.tabib_dermawan.mulai: Sky Healer! Ha, the slum children gave you that name. You know, they come here now to learn to dress wounds. You cured more than a fever.
kultivator.cerita.tabib_sapa.baik: Everyone says that until they are carried in on a stretcher. Drink ginger tea, sleep before midnight.
kultivator.cerita.tabib_sapa.mulai: Sit. Hold out your hand. ...Your pulse is taut as a bowstring. You fight too much and sleep too little.
kultivator.cerita.tabib_sapa.mulai.2: Why is the corner bed always empty?
kultivator.cerita.tabib_sapa.penyimpanga: Qi running down the wrong road. First tingling, then heat in the chest, then dreams that are not yours. Never break through angry or hungry. If it happens, come here before the dreams start talking.
kultivator.cerita.tabib_sapa.ranjang: That was my master's bed. She tended people there for forty years and died there peacefully. People say the bed is unlucky. I leave it empty for another reason.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.1.pembuka: The capital gates open before you. A new notice hangs on the Yamen board: "People missing in the Slums."
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.2.pembuka: Three children and a greengrocer vanished in a week. The guards will not enter the slum alleys after dark.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.3.pembuka: Yan Ruyi collapsed during the morning rites. The palace physicians smell iron on her breath: blood venom.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.4.pembuka: Prince Yan wishes to withdraw to the mountains. The city must choose: just but frail Ruyi, or able Gu Lianshan, beloved of merchants.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.5.pembuka: The proofs point to one man who always smiles politely behind Minister Gu.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.6.pembuka: The sky turns red. Beasts roar beyond the walls, and inside the city rises a laughter that is not human.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.bab.7.pembuka: Lanterns are lit at noon. The whole city gathers in the Grand Square to see who takes the throne.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.gerhana.kakek: Grandpa Mud stands beside you. "The child said you were a good one," he says, and the air around you hardens like a shield.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.gerhana.serang: Mo Ying's disciples strike from the shadows!
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.1.tiba: You reached the capital; Tie Hu wrote your name in the gate book.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.2.bebas: The captives came home. A Shadow Seal was left in the demon lair.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.2.hilang: The missing were never found. The slums lock their doors earlier now.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.3.dibeli: Ruyi recovered through a Black Market pill; nobody knows where it came from.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.3.lemah: Ruyi survived, but her body stays frail.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.3.sembuh: Ruyi recovered through a pill brewed by honest hands.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.4.gu: The merchants and guilds chose Gu Lianshan.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.4.netral: The city is split; nobody wants to speak first.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.4.ruyi: The guild heads stand behind Ruyi.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.5.a: An open trial at the Yamen unmasked Mo Ying. He fled through the roof.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.5.b: Mo Ying fell in a duel in a Cloud District warehouse. His mask broke.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.5.c: The proofs were burned. Mo Ying smiles wider.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.5.tersemb: Mo Ying stays hidden behind his smile.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.6.bertaha: The guards held until dawn, at great cost.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.6.menang: The demonic assault was broken at the gates. The city still stands.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.7.gu: Gu Lianshan is crowned. Shops are fuller, fines heavier, the Black Market raided more often.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.hasil.7.ruyi: Yan Ruyi is crowned. Prices are fair again and the guards kinder.
kultivator.cerita.takhta.inspired: Source: Inspired by the tales of Judge Bao Zheng (Song dynasty), who exposed the crimes of officials, and by the xianxia trope of demonic-path spies in a palace; the characters and the plot are game design.
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_bao.bantu: If you find something, bring it to me. Not rumours; proof. Rumours I can hear for free at the teahouse.
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_bao.mulai: You read the board? Good. Most people only read the price of rice. The Yamen is short of hands: the guards fear the slum alleys after dark, and the beggars will not speak to a uniform.
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_bao.takut: Because two of them went into those alleys last month and came out remembering nothing. No wounds, no memory. That is no common thief's work.
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_tie_hu.hilang: Three children and a greengrocer, all in one week. My superiors say it is the Yamen's business, not the gate's. Magistrate Bao posted a notice this morning. If you want to be useful, go see him.
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_tie_hu.mulai: Halt there. ...Ah, a newcomer. Write your name in the gate book. Since the slums started losing people, I note every face that comes in.
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_tie_hu.mulai.2: (Write your name in the gate book)
kultivator.cerita.takhta1_tie_hu.tulis: Poor hand, good name. Welcome to the capital. Remember the first law: within the walls, swords sleep.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_bao_cap.mulai: A Shadow Seal. An upturned lotus. The sign of the demonic path, found with the children of my city. Someone inside these walls gives them a way in and out. I will find the hand that holds this seal.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.gang: Here, in the alley behind the salt warehouse. Look, the strap is torn, and this... is blood. Not animal blood: the dogs will not come near.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.gang.1: I will find Xiao Tu. I promise.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.gang.2: Go home and lock the door.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.janji: A promise? Grandpa Mud says a strong person's promise is heavy. If you break it, heaven collects the debt. ...But I believe you. A little.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.mulai: Shh! Not so loud. Are you from the Yamen? ...My friend Xiao Tu vanished three nights ago. We sleep under the bridge, and in the morning only his sandal was left.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.mulai.2: (Give a sweet) You are safe with me.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.mulai.2.al: You do not have a single Spirit Value.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_dou.percaya: ...You are not lying? Grown-ups always lie. Fine. Follow me, but do not step in the puddles; the puddles here have ears.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_kakek.bakpao: Hm. A warm bun opens an old mouth. Sit down; do not stand there like a laundry pole.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_kakek.iblis: Do not shout. The walls of this city have ears, and some of those ears wear an official's ring.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_kakek.tahu: At night a man in a black robe passes here. His feet do not touch the mud, and the mud here touches everyone. He dropped this.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_saksi.lihat: ...A covered cart, out through the east gate before dawn. The guards did not search it. The guards NEVER fail to search a cart. Unless the cart carries a letter from the palace.
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_saksi.mulai: What do you want? I saw nothing. Nothing!
kultivator.cerita.takhta2_saksi.mulai.1: (Give 2 SV) Just tell me what you saw.
He does not trust you enough yet (Good Name 5).
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_dan_chen.cepat: There is. The Black Market sells finished pills. Nobody knows who made them, and I would not touch one even with my chopsticks. But... the heir's life will not wait for my pride.
Then I will find the ingredients.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_dan_chen.mulai: You. Yes, you. Your hands are still rough, but today I have no choice. The heir has been given blood venom. Three palace physicians are weeping in the corridor. I do not weep; I count.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_dan_chen.resep: The Blood Venom Antidote Pill. The formula is in my head, the ingredients are not on my shelves: Spirit Spring Water, or Starwort from a Spirit Vein Cave. One is enough, if the flame is honest. Take this recipe.
I will go to a spirit spring.
I will go to a Spirit Vein Cave.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_pasar.beli: A pleasure doing business. If anyone asks, you were never here, and I was never born.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_pasar.mulai: A blood venom antidote? Everyone wants one today. Strange, isn't it, as if someone knew the venom would be used.
A Black Market pill costs far more than your purse holds.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_pasar.siapa: Trade secret. ...Fine, one free word: someone from the palace bought the venom's ingredients first. A very polite man. Too polite for this market.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_ruyi.mulai: They say you brought the pill. I will never forget this kindness. Take this badge; my hand still trembles, do not laugh.
kultivator.cerita.takhta3_ruyi.siapa: The morning tea. Always poured by the same hands, from the same pot. That day it smelled of iron. I will not accuse without proof; Magistrate Bao would scold me.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_bao_qing.mulai: A magistrate takes no claimant's side. A magistrate takes the law's side. If you come for my name, bring a reason that can be read aloud in court.
My claimant will swear before witnesses to uphold the law.
Bao Qing does not know you well enough (Good Name 10).
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_bao_qing.setuj: ...The Yamen takes no side. But my name may be written among the witnesses of that oath. Only that, and that is a great deal.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_dan_chen.mulai: Politics? I am an alchemist. ...But a pill without an honest healer is only a polite poison. Who is your claimant, and why should I care?
You have seen my care at the furnace.
Dan Chen only listens to alchemists who passed his exam.
You lack the money for a fitting gift.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_dan_chen.setuj: Hm. Very well. The Alchemist Guild will stand behind your claimant. Do not make me regret it; I hate regret more than I hate novices.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_gu.kenapa: Because I was born on the market street, counting other people's coins. This city gave me everything; I want to repay my debt with interest. That is ambition, yes. Ambition is no sin.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_gu.kumuh: The slums need work, not free porridge. The new salt warehouse will employ two hundred. Porridge is gone in a day; wages come every month.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_gu.mulai: Have you heard? The Prince is withdrawing. I do not ask for your support, only your common sense. The treasury is half empty; I can fill it in three seasons.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_gu.mulai.2: Why do you want the throne?
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_lin_fei.cerita: Twenty years ago the east wall nearly fell, and what held it was no prince, no minister, but builders and hunters. Whoever sits on the throne must remember who stood on the wall. Does yours remember?
They will. I will make sure of it.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_lin_fei.mulai: The Cultivators' Guild's backing? We follow whoever wins in the field, not in meetings. Show me your hand.
Lin Fei laughs: "Come back when your realm is higher."
(Buy her drink, 5 SV) Tell me why you care.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_lin_fei.setuju: Your hand will do. The Cultivators' Guild backs you. If your claimant betrays the city, I will drag them to the Arena myself.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ou_ye.mulai: Talking politics in a forge. Hm.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ou_ye.mulai.1: (Hand over eight iron ingots for the guild forge)
Ou Ye glances at your empty hands.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ou_ye.mulai.2: You once forged a sword with me.
You have never stood at the same anvil.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ou_ye.setuju: Good iron. The Forge Guild is with you. That is all.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_pangeran.calon: Ruyi: just, stubborn, frail of body. Gu Lianshan: able, counts as fast as a banker, beloved of merchants. I am Ruyi's father, so my voice does not count. Yours, perhaps, does.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_pangeran.mulai: You are the one who was there when the city needed hands. Sit. I am withdrawing to the mountains. The guild council must choose my successor, and the council listens to those the people trust.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_pangeran.pilih: A sensible choice. The city needs hands that can count. Win three of the five city heads: Dan Chen, Lin Fei, Madam Qian, Young Ou Ye, Magistrate Bao.
Neutrality is a choice too, and this city was built on it. I will not press you.
Your heart chooses bravely. A heart is not enough: win three of the five city heads. Dan Chen, Lin Fei, Madam Qian, Young Ou Ye, Magistrate Bao. They cannot be bought, but they can be convinced.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_qian_duoduo.mu: The Money House's backing has a price, sir. Not a bribe; a surety. House Qian never backs a side that cannot pay its promises.
The surety is larger than your purse.
You already know I am honest.
Madam Qian has never done business with you.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_qian_duoduo.se: Recorded, in red ink: House Qian gives its backing. Do not be offended; red ink is for people I trust.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ruyi.gu: Gu Lianshan is clever, and I do not hate him. But his plans always start at the treasury and end at the treasury. Where are the people?
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ruyi.lemah: My body is frail. My law is not.
kultivator.cerita.takhta4_ruyi.mulai: Father wants to withdraw. I do not ask for the throne; I ask for the granaries to open. If the throne is the only key to the granaries, then I want the throne.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_bao.curiga: A magistrate who suspects before the proof is whole is a magistrate who punishes out of hatred. I wait. You run.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_bao.mulai: Poison in the palace. A Shadow Seal in the slums. Palace money vanishing every month. Three threads, one knot. I need two more proofs: the Money House ledgers, and the spy hiding in the temple.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_bao_pilih.adil: The evidence is complete. I pronounce the verdict! Bring Mo Ying before me!
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_bao_pilih.mula: Here is the proof. Try him.
You do not hold three proofs: the Shadow Seal, the Secret Ledger, the Spy's Letter.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_bao_pilih.send: Stubborn. He is in the Cloud District warehouse every night, counting salt crates that hold no salt. If you die there, I cannot put you on trial.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_jing_xin.altar: Behind the altar, perhaps. I can open it, but I must be sure your heart does not seek revenge. Go to the Heart Mirror Cave outside the city. Look into its pool. If you return without wishing to kill, I will open the altar.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_jing_xin.mulai: A pilgrim comes every third day. He kneels without incense and without prayer. He is not praying; he is counting the guards.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_mo_ying.mulai: Honoured sir. You carry such heavy papers. Allow me to lighten them.
You are the one behind it.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_mo_ying.terima: Very wise. Those papers will burn beautifully. We never met, did we?
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_mo_ying.topeng: You noticed too late...! But this warehouse is quiet, and I do like quiet places.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_mo_ying_duel.m: Magistrate Bao sent you alone? How very just. Come, I shall record your defeat neatly.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_qian.beri: House Qian has not torn its books in nine hundred years. Today I tear one. Use it wisely, and bring it back when the city is safe; I hate books with holes.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_qian.kiri: That is the odd part. Minister Gu is left-handed; he stamps with his left, leaning right. The seal on this page leans left. Someone close to him uses his seal.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_qian.mulai: From Magistrate Bao? Sit, and do not touch my abacus. ...Every month four hundred spirit stones leave the palace account for a nameless one, stamped with the Minister's seal.
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_qian.mulai.1: So Minister Gu is the culprit?
kultivator.cerita.takhta5_surat.mulai: You have returned, and your eyes are calm. This is what I found behind the altar: a letter in the same hand as that ledger. The shadow writes with a cold hand.
kultivator.cerita.takhta6_feng_ao.mulai: Hmph. Do not misunderstand. I am here because this is the city where I will be number one, and a burning city has no rankings. I have your back. Just this once.
kultivator.cerita.takhta6_tie_hu.mulai: The east gate! They are not coming by the road, they are coming out of the shadows! You, with me!
kultivator.cerita.takhta6_tie_hu.muncul: There they are! Black robes, upturned lotus! Do not let them reach the granary!
kultivator.cerita.takhta7_upacara.mulai: People of the capital! Nine hundred years ago seven sects planted their swords in this stone and swore an oath. Today I plant something lighter: my office.
kultivator.cerita.takhta7_upacara.serah: From this day, I entrust this capital to %s. Keep its oath: within the walls, swords sleep.
kultivator.cerita.tawanan_sapa.ikut: I will walk right behind you. If I stop, it is only because my legs shake, not from fear. A little from fear.
kultivator.cerita.tawanan_sapa.mulai: We're saved... thank you, truly! Please, take me home to my village. I dare not walk alone; every shadow looks like a black robe.
kultivator.cerita.tawanan_sapa.mulai.1: Come with me. I will take you home.
kultivator.cerita.tawanan_sapa.mulai.2: Run toward the sunrise; the village lies that way.
kultivator.cerita.teka.0.soal: I have a mouth but never eat, banks but never sit, I always run yet have no feet.
kultivator.cerita.teka.1.soal: The more you take from me, the bigger I grow.
kultivator.cerita.teka.10.soal: I have one eye, yet I can see nothing.
kultivator.cerita.teka.11.soal: No wings, yet I fly; no eyes, yet I cry.
kultivator.cerita.teka.12.soal: I come at night uncalled and vanish by day unstolen.
kultivator.cerita.teka.13.soal: I carry my house on my back wherever I go.
kultivator.cerita.teka.14.soal: Feed me and I live; give me a drink and I die.
kultivator.cerita.teka.15.soal: I fill a whole room yet take up no space at all.
kultivator.cerita.teka.16.soal: I do not weep when I am cut, but the one who cuts me does.
kultivator.cerita.teka.17.soal: I am hard as stone, born of mud, and give water to the whole house.
kultivator.cerita.teka.18.soal: Speak my name and you break me.
kultivator.cerita.teka.19.soal: If you have me, you want to share me; if you share me, I am gone.
kultivator.cerita.teka.2.soal: I am light as a feather, yet the strongest man cannot hold me for long.
kultivator.cerita.teka.20.soal: By day I hide in the sky; by night I light the road for travellers.
kultivator.cerita.teka.21.soal: I have many teeth, yet I never bite.
kultivator.cerita.teka.22.soal: Planted without seed, grown without water, harvested with a sword.
kultivator.cerita.teka.23.soal: The beggar has it, the rich man needs it, and if you eat it you die.
kultivator.cerita.teka.24.soal: Every day I walk from east to west without feet, and never tire.
kultivator.cerita.teka.25.soal: The older I get, the more I am worth; people bury me just to wait.
kultivator.cerita.teka.26.soal: I never gain an ounce, yet the longer you carry me, the heavier I become.
kultivator.cerita.teka.27.soal: I have a head and a tail, but no body.
kultivator.cerita.teka.28.soal: I have many leaves, yet I am no plant.
kultivator.cerita.teka.29.soal: I can break without anyone touching me.
kultivator.cerita.teka.3.soal: I have cities without houses, forests without trees, and rivers without water.
kultivator.cerita.teka.30.soal: I go into the water, yet I am never wet.
kultivator.cerita.teka.31.soal: I shout without a mouth and answer whenever I am called.
kultivator.cerita.teka.32.soal: You buy me to eat, yet you never eat me.
kultivator.cerita.teka.33.soal: Five brothers live in one house, and no two are the same length.
kultivator.cerita.teka.34.soal: My seven colours come after rain, yet no one can hold me.
kultivator.cerita.teka.35.soal: I cut without a blade and heal without medicine.
kultivator.cerita.teka.36.soal: The longer I live, the shorter I grow.
kultivator.cerita.teka.37.soal: I was given to you, yet others use me far more than you do.
kultivator.cerita.teka.38.soal: I fly without wings and pray without a voice, released into the sky on a full-moon night.
kultivator.cerita.teka.39.soal: Round as the moon, sweet as honey, shared with family on a full-moon night.
kultivator.cerita.teka.4.soal: You must break me before you can use me.
kultivator.cerita.teka.5.soal: I am always in front of you, yet you can never see me.
kultivator.cerita.teka.6.soal: What always goes up but never comes down?
kultivator.cerita.teka.7.soal: I have a neck but no head.
kultivator.cerita.teka.8.soal: The more I dry, the wetter I become.
kultivator.cerita.teka.9.soal: Four legs in the morning, two at noon, three in the evening.
kultivator.cerita.teka_sapa.benar: A hole! Right! You have a clear head. Save it for festival night; my riddles there are much crueller.
kultivator.cerita.teka_sapa.kapan: On the full-moon night the city calendar sets. All of Lantern Street will hang with riddles, and I will stand here until my voice gives out.
kultivator.cerita.teka_sapa.mulai: Riddles, riddles! One right answer, one charm; one wrong answer, one laugh. Try this one? Free, since it is not festival time yet.
kultivator.cerita.teka_sapa.salah: Ha! No. A hole. The more you dig, the bigger it gets. ...A debt too, actually, but that is sadder.
kultivator.cerita.teka_sapa.soal: "The more you take from me, the bigger I become." What am I?
kultivator.cerita.tetua_desa_sapa.kisah: When I was my grandson's age, the river rose to the granary. We all climbed to the Earth God's shrine on the hill, and the water stopped right at the third step. Since then we offer every first harvest on that step.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_desa_sapa.kultiv: Once. A thin young man who asked for water at our well, sixty years ago. Ten years later he passed again, flying on a sword. He waved. I still do not know his name.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_desa_sapa.mulai: Sit on this bench, child. This bench is older than the village head, and wiser too, because it never talks.
Have you ever met a great cultivator?
What is your advice for me?
kultivator.cerita.tetua_desa_sapa.nasiha: Do not forget to eat. Every strong person I knew forgot to eat, then forgot to come home, then forgot who was waiting for them. Start with eating.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_iblis_ancam.mula: Don't think you'll leave alive! Your blood will be ink for my talismans.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_klan_hormat.mula: The one who made the young master kiss the dust! Since that day he trains before dawn and stopped shouting at servants. The ancestors must be laughing in their hall.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_klan_remeh.mulai: Oh, the one who yielded. No matter; yielding water also wears through stone in the end. But in this clan, people judge by who stands, not who is wise.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_klan_sapa.mulai: You stand in our clan's ancestral yard. Be polite. The ancestors like to watch, and they hold grudges.
What do you think of the young master?
kultivator.cerita.tetua_klan_sapa.sejara: Our first ancestor was a hunter who saved a sect elder from a spirit tiger. In return he was given one technique and one piece of advice. The technique we passed down; the advice we forgot, which is why we are still a small clan.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_klan_sapa.tuan_m: Talent like a flood, patience like a leaking bucket. His father spoils him. Perhaps he needs to lose once to the right person.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_bijak.lore: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_bijak.mula: Your steps carry the dust of many roads. Sit; the tea in this sect is older than some of its disciples.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_bijak.topi: You have been learning since you arrived. A sect only gives names to what you learn.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_curiga.lor: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_curiga.mul: You are not our disciple. What you see here is not to be told outside.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_curiga.top: Study? Or steal techniques? Many arrive with the first word and leave with the second.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_jujur.lore: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_jujur.mula: Welcome. Our sect is not large, but we hide nothing from a polite guest.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_jujur.topi: If you want to learn, learn from the outer disciples first. They teach what elders do not: patience.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_licik.lore: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_licik.mula: A guest! You came just in time. Our sect is... in need of friends with strong hands.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_licik.topi: Of course, of course. Every guest may learn. Every guest may also help us a little. Give and take.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_penakut.lo: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_penakut.mu: Y-you came alone? No army behind you? Good. Very good.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_penakut.to: Ask the Sect Master. I would not dare decide anything without the Master.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_ramah.lore: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_ramah.mula: A guest of the sect! An outer disciple will show you the way. Do not hesitate to ask.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_ramah.topi: Our gate opens on every Gate Opening Day. Bring a patient heart and strong legs; the stairs are long.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_serakah.lo: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_serakah.mu: Honoured guest. Our sect accepts offerings in any form. Spirit stones are preferred.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_serakah.to: Learning has a price. Free knowledge is usually cheap knowledge.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_sombong.lo: The founder of %s split a mountain in two and built the hall in the gap, so every disciple who climbs the steps learns one thing: even stone gives way to resolve. At least, so the story goes. The rock is certainly split.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_sombong.mu: You stand in the courtyard of the greatest sect in this region. Most guests wait three days to enter.
kultivator.cerita.tetua_sekte_sombong.to: Study here? Our entrance trial has made clan children weep. You are welcome to try.
kultivator.cerita.tie_hu_sapa.jam: The night drum sounds at ten. After that the gates stay shut until dawn. If you are late, two Spirit Value for the guard, and do not tell me you did not know.
kultivator.cerita.tie_hu_sapa.mulai: Welcome to the capital. Private fights are forbidden within the walls. Your name?
kultivator.cerita.tie_hu_sapa.nasihat: Do not cross the slums after dark. People go missing there, and my superiors say that is the Yamen's business, not the gate's.
kultivator.cerita.tie_hu_sapa.tegang: Me? No. A gate captain is never tense. He is only... careful, since the Minister began checking the gate book himself.
kultivator.cerita.tikus_ma.mulai: A spirit rat in Zhu's kitchen? Ha! Take Stripes. She fears nothing in this world, except Zhu when he sings.
kultivator.cerita.tikus_tawar.jerat: Snares! We need snares! String, lots of string. I will steam buns for bait. My best buns. Such a waste.
kultivator.cerita.tikus_tawar.mulai: Shh! You... you are a cultivator, right? There is... there is a SPIRIT RAT in the storeroom! Huge! Glowing eyes! It ate a whole sack of spirit rice last night!
kultivator.cerita.tikus_tawar.takut: Me? I am a cook! Cooks cut meat that already lies still! This one... this one LOOKED AT ME!
kultivator.cerita.tokoh.ou_ye.gelar: Master Smith of the Forge Guild
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_bijak.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_bijak.mulai: You walk like someone who has lost and learned from it. I envy that.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_bijak.topik: Patience. The sword is only the excuse. My teacher says a hurried sword cuts its owner.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_curiga.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_curiga.mulai: You have been watching me. Why? Who sent you?
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_curiga.topik: Why do you want to know? ...The spear. Satisfied?
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_duel.mulai: You dare come back? Good. Let us finish this!
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_jujur.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_jujur.mulai: Greetings. I am still learning to lead, so if anyone in this village is rude, tell me.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_jujur.topik: The fist. Father wants the sword, but my hands are more honest without steel.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_licik.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_licik.mulai: You are strong, yes? How about a wager? I am sure I will win. Unless I do not.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_licik.topik: The sword, and a little poison on the hilt. Joking! ...Probably.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_penakut.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_penakut.mula: D-do not tell father you saw me hiding in the barn.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_penakut.topi: The sword. But I would rather write poems. Poems do not bleed.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_ramah.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_ramah.mulai: Oh, a guest! Sorry about the gate guards; they are too serious. Want to train together?
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_ramah.topik: The clan sword, thirty-six forms. I have only mastered twenty. Do not tell my father I said "only".
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_serakah.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_serakah.mula: You have a fine sword. How much? Everything has a price.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_serakah.topi: Whatever earns me free pills from my father. At the moment, the sword.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_sombong.lore: Everyone looks at me the way they look at a granary: hoping it is full. If I fall, my father's name falls. You think arrogance is easy? Arrogance is armour.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_sombong.mula: Know your place. You are speaking to the heir of this clan.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_sombong.topi: Everything there is. And I have mastered all of it. Nearly.
What is it like to be the clan's heir?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_tantang.hina: Only passing? The whole village saw you not bow to me! Accept my challenge, or kneel!
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_tantang.mula: You. An outsider who walks our clan's road as if you owned it. Know your place!
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_tantang.mund: ...I-I was only testing your courage! Yes. You pass. Now go before I change my mind.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_tantang.tawa: Ha! You see? Even an outsider knows who rules here!
kultivator.cerita.tuan_muda_ulang.mulai: Father says you want to try again. Do not yield this time; it was boring.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_wen_sapa.gilda: Three guilds, three tempers. Alchemists count flames, smiths count blows, cultivators count beast heads. They have quarrelled since the city was founded, and that is why no single party ever ruled it.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_wen_sapa.kacamata: Oh! So they are. Thank you, thank you. Forty years I have looked for the same thing in the same place.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_wen_sapa.mulai: Quiet in the library, please. Now. Which book do you seek? Wait, where did I put my spectacles...
kultivator.cerita.tuan_wen_sapa.mulai.2: What do you know of the guilds?
kultivator.cerita.tuan_wen_sapa.mulai.3: Your spectacles are on your head.
kultivator.cerita.tuan_wen_sapa.perpus: Copies of the founding manuals of every sect that ever swore the city oath are kept here. No sect can attack the capital without burning its own knowledge. That is true neutrality: not walls, but bookshelves.
kultivator.cerita.tukang_sapa.atap: So evil spirits that walk straight slip off the end. My master said so. My other master said so rain falls far from the walls. Both are right, and both make roofs expensive.
kultivator.cerita.tukang_sapa.bangun: Repairing, rather. Someone makes holes, we patch them. When cultivators fight, builders eat well for a month. Do not say I am glad; I am not glad. A little.
kultivator.cerita.tukang_sapa.mulai: Mind your head, plank coming through! ...Heave! If you want to help, that rope needs pulling. If not, step aside a little, please.
kultivator.cerita.tukang_sapa.mulai.2: Why do the roofs curve like that?
kultivator.cerita.tukang_takut.lega: ...Thank you. Sorry. My knees knelt before my head had time to think.
kultivator.cerita.tukang_takut.mulai: (The builder drops his hammer and bows low.) M-my lord... we are working as fast as we can, truly. Nobody is complaining. Nobody is billing anyone. Please, go ahead.
kultivator.cerita.tukang_takut.mulai.1: Get up. I will not hurt you.
kultivator.cerita.tungku_pertama_nilai.l: Passed. First Alchemist Rank. Do not smile yet; the Second Rank will make you weep.
kultivator.cerita.tungku_pertama_nilai.m: Let me see... Round in shape, even in colour, and its smell does not make my eyes water. Hm.
kultivator.cerita.tungku_pertama_tawar.m: Still here? Hm. If you want more than watching, take the First Rank exam. The fee is small; the shame of failing is large.
The exam fee is not in your purse.
kultivator.cerita.tungku_pertama_tawar.t: Any furnace will do. An honest flame does not care where it burns. Bring your pill here, and do not smile before I allow it.
kultivator.cerita.uji.tanpa_npc: No NPC nearby can say it and no new body could be called.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h1: First illusion: heavy rain. Today's stone is very heavy, and no one would know if you skipped it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h1.1: Carry the stone. One day is still one day.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h1.3: Pay someone else to carry it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h2: Second illusion: a cultivator offers to fly you up and build the stair with a technique in a single day.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h2.2: Decline politely; this stair is building me too.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h2.3: Ask him to build two stairs.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h3: Third illusion: the stair is done, and nobody knows who built it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.h3.1: Carve your name on the first step.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.k1: I was a porter at the foot of the Mountain of a Thousand Prayers. Old pilgrims often fell on the steep path.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.k2: Every day I carried one flat stone up and set it as a step. One stone a day, forty years. My bones grew as hard as the stones I carried.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.k3: When the stair reached the top, I was old. I sat on the last step and watched a grandmother climb without falling. A body tempered by kindness never tires.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Shi Ban, The Stone Bearer. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_1_pamit.m: One stone a day. That is my whole secret, and now it is yours.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h1: First illusion: the roof falls. You can get out alone now, or hold the beam for the others.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h1.3: Break stone for your own way out.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h2: Second illusion: the third day. Your back is cracking. One miner is still inside.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h2.1: Let go; you have saved enough.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h2.2: Hold one more breath, then another.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h3: Third illusion: the miners want to raise a statue of you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.h3.1: Ask them to build better roof supports instead.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.k1: I was a body cultivator who worked in a spirit mine. The miners laughed because I refused tools; I broke stone with my hands.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.k2: One day the mine roof collapsed. Forty miners were trapped. I held the main beam on my back for three days and three nights while they dug their way out.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.k3: When the last miner was out, my bones were cracked in a hundred places. They knit again stronger than iron. A body grows strong not by striking, but by holding.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Tie Gu, Iron Bones. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_2_pamit.m: Iron bones are not born from blows. They are born from burdens you refuse to drop.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h1: First illusion: you can make your body invulnerable, but you will never feel anything again.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h2: Second illusion: your child reaches for your hand, but your skin is hard as stone.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h2.1: Soften your hand, even if it weakens you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h2.2: Pull your hand away so they are not hurt.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h3: Third illusion: two valleys parted by cliffs. Merchants die climbing.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h3.1: Smash the cliff with your fist.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.h3.2: Lie down and become the road.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.k1: My body grew so strong that no weapon could wound me. I walked through wars without a single scratch.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.k2: But a body that cannot be wounded cannot feel either. I could not feel my child's hand. I could not feel warm tea. I became a walking mountain, and the mountain was lonely.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.k3: At the end of my life I lay down between two valleys parted by cliffs and became a mountain pass, a road for merchants. The highest body is a body others can pass through.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Pan Yue, The Walking Mountain. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_body_3_pamit.m: Be strong as a mountain, but remember: the best mountains have a path.

kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.h1: First illusion: a blizzard, the wood is gone, and the embers are dying. What do you burn?
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.h2: Second illusion: a merchant offers gold for your furnace, to carry it to the city.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.h2.2: This fire is not mine; it belongs to those who sleep around it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.h3: Third illusion: a child is afraid of the furnace fire.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.h3.1: Show them how to roast sweet potatoes in the embers.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.h3.2: Tell them fire is dangerous, stay away.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.k1: I was the smith of a mountain village with long winters. My furnace was the only fire there that never went out.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.k2: Forty winters, every night, the villagers slept around my furnace. I learned to pour qi into the embers so a little wood would last until morning.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.k3: In my last winter the wood ran out. I fed the furnace with my own qi until dawn. The village woke up warm. I did not wake, but I was warm.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Tao Hong, Keeper of the Village Furnace. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_1_pamit.m: The best fire is not the biggest, but the one that keeps others warm the longest.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h1: First illusion: you are burning, and the fire offers new life if you give up one memory.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h1.1: Give up the most painful memory.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h1.2: Give up the memory you clutch hardest, even if it is beautiful.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h2: Second illusion: your ash speaks with your old voice, asking you to become who you were.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h2.1: Go back. My old self was stronger.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h2.2: Thank the ash, then step forward.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h3: Third illusion: your disciples are cold and little of your fire remains.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h3.1: Keep your fire to rise again.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.h3.2: Give a spark to each of them.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.k1: Three times in my life I burned, and three times I rose from my own ash. People called me a phoenix. They did not know the price.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.k2: Each time I rose, I lost something: my mother's name, my beloved's face, the song of my childhood. Fire does not burn only the body; it burns whatever you hold too tightly.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.k3: The fourth time, I chose not to rise. I gave my fire to my disciples, a spark for each. Rising does not always mean becoming your old self again.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Yan Zhuo, Ash Phoenix. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_2_pamit.m: If you burn, do not fear becoming ash. Fear becoming a fire that warms no one.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h1: First illusion: a great enemy assaults your city. Your second sun could burn them, and half the city.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h1.1: Kindle the sun. Half a city is better than none.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h1.2: Make your fire a warm wall around the city.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h2: Second illusion: a mother asks you to warm her freezing baby.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h2.1: Kindle a flame as small as a candle in your palm.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h2.2: Refuse; your fire is too great for a baby.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h2.3: Tell her to find a physician.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h3: Third illusion: you see the glass lakes that were once mountains.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h3.1: Be proud; they prove your strength.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.h3.2: Plant trees on their shores, one by one.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.k1: At the peak of my cultivation I could kindle a second sun in the sky. My enemies evaporated before they came near. Mountains melted into glass lakes.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.k2: Then came a long drought. My sun could not bring rain, could not grow rice, could not warm a baby without burning it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.k3: I spent three hundred years learning to make a flame as small as a candle, enough to read by, enough to cook porridge. That is the highest fire: warmth, not ruin.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Chi Yao, The Second Sun. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_fire_3_pamit.m: I put out the second sun long ago. What I leave you is its candle.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.h1: First illusion: hungry children beg for the seed you keep.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.h1.2: Give them your own food, keep the seed.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.h2: Second illusion: people call you cruel and ice-hearted.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.h2.1: Let them talk; spring will answer.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.h3: Third illusion: spring comes. A landlord bids for all the seed.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.h3.2: Return it to each village as they entrusted it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.k1: I gathered frost herbs on the northern slopes. When the great famine came, the villages ate their own seed rice.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.k2: I gathered the last seed from every village and froze it in an ice cave with my qi. Hungry people cursed me for hoarding food.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.k3: The next spring I gave the seed back. The valley turned green again. Cold is not cruelty; cold is how hope is kept until its season comes.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Bai Shuang, Keeper of the Frozen Seed. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_1_pamit.mu: Good cold preserves; it does not bite. Remember that whenever your hands turn to ice.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.h1: First illusion: your lost beloved smiles before you and offers to be forgotten.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.h1.1: Forget them so it no longer hurts.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.h1.2: Remember them, and let the pain be yours.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.h2: Second illusion: your disciple has a fever and calls your name.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.h2.2: Send a physician; you are cultivating.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.h3: Third illusion: your heart thaws and a hundred years of grief arrive at once.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.k1: My beloved fell in a sect war. I froze my own heart so I would not feel the grief.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.k2: For a hundred years I did not weep, laugh or fear. My cultivation soared. My disciples called me the moon: bright, beautiful, and untouchable.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.k3: Until a little disciple died of fever, and I felt nothing. That night I thawed my heart. The grief came all at once, a hundred years in one night. I chose that grief over emptiness.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Han Yue, Cold Moon. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_2_pamit.mu: Let the cold be your weapon. Never let it be your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h1: First illusion: a giant wave is coming. You can freeze it or save yourself.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h1.1: Freeze the wave, even if you can never leave.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h1.2: Fly away; the rest is heaven's business.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h2: Second illusion: seventy years pass. No one remembers your name.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h2.1: Carve your name into the ice wall.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h2.2: Keep sitting. The wall matters, not the name.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h3: Third illusion: the sea is calm. Your wall must be thawed.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.h3.2: Thaw it drop by drop, until no one floods.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.k1: When the eastern sea rose into a mountain-high wave, I stood on the shore and froze it. A whole province was saved behind a wall of ice a thousand li long.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.k2: The wall had to be held so it would not fall. I sat on its crest for seventy years, unmoving, until snow covered me and people forgot someone was there.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.k3: When the sea grew calm, I thawed the wall slowly, drop by drop, so not one village flooded. I left without a trace. The greatest strength is the one that leaves no scar.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Xue Wuhen, Traceless Snow. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_ice_3_pamit.mu: Walk without a trace, and let only kindness remain behind.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.h1: First illusion: a rich man offers gold to be treated before a poor man who is sicker.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.h1.2: Take the gold; it buys herbs for everyone.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.h2: Second illusion: the grass you need grows in the yard of someone who hates you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.h2.2: Knock on the door and ask honestly.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.h3: Third illusion: the last cure in your hand. You and a child are both ill.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.h3.1: Drink it; a physician must live to help more.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.k1: I was a village physician too poor for rare herbs. I learned to heal with the weeds by the roadside.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.k2: When the fever plague came, I treated three villages without pay. I found that the grass everyone trampled held the strongest cure.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.k3: I saved my last patient, then fell ill myself. The cure was in my hand, but I gave it to a child. Life does not belong to those who keep it; it belongs to those who give it away.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Cao Lu, Physician of Weeds. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_1_pamit.m: Bow when you see the grass by the road. It may save someone's life today.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h1: First illusion: you plant a tree for your comrade. Someone asks you to plant one for the enemy who killed him too.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h1.1: Plant one for that enemy too.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h1.3: Plant it, then cut it down secretly.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h2: Second illusion: drought. Your young trees are dying.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h2.2: Carry water from the river, one bucket at a time.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h2.3: Let them be; the strong will survive.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h3: Third illusion: a king wants to fell your forest to build a palace.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.h3.2: Walk him through the forest and name every tree.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.k1: I was a soldier in the war of the seven sects. The field where I fought became dead ground; nothing grows on blood.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.k2: After the war I returned to that field with a bag of seeds. Every tree I planted I named after someone who fell there, friend or foe.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.k3: Two hundred years later the field was a breathing forest. Children of all seven sects played beneath it. Life grown from death is the only victory with no losing side.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Mu Qing, The Breathing Forest. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_2_pamit.m: Plant something in every place you have ever wounded.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h1: First illusion: a mother carries her dead child and begs.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h1.2: Sit with her and weep together.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h1.3: Send her away; I do not raise the dead.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h2: Second illusion: you could erase winter forever.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h2.1: Erase it; no one will freeze again.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h2.2: Let winter be; without it spring means nothing.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h3: Third illusion: your own body begins to wither with age.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.h3.2: Let it be, and plant flowers where you will lie.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.k1: I could revive the withered. One touch, and dead fields bloomed, fallen trees stood, dry rivers ran.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.k2: People came carrying their dead. "Bring them back," they said. I could. But what returned was no longer the one they loved.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.k3: I stopped reviving the dead and began teaching people to grieve. Spring is not a season without death; spring is the season that grows out of winter.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Chun Shen, Goddess of Spring. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.mulai.2: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_life_3_pamit.m: The life I leave you includes its death. Hold both with equally gentle hands.
