Ring the bell as hard as you can, laughter or not.
Stay quiet; let them learn for themselves.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.h2: Second illusion: you could guide the lightning to the house of the one who mocked you.
Guide it to the iron pole on the hill.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.h3: Third illusion: a child is struck by lightning and lives, as you once did.
Teach them to hear the storms.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.k1: Lightning struck me when I was a small herd boy. I lived, and since then I could hear a storm three days before it came.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.k2: I hung a great bell on the hill and rang it whenever a storm drew near. Herders brought their flocks home, fishermen pulled in their boats. People called me the fool who runs in the rain.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.k3: I taught the lightning to fall on iron poles I planted, not on people's houses. The power of lightning is not in its loudness, but in its warning.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.mu: I am the remnant soul of Lei Dazhuang, Ringer of the Storm Bell. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1.te: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_1_pa: If you hear a storm, ring the bell. Let people laugh; they will laugh inside dry houses.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.da: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.go: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.h1: First illusion: you could call your tribulation now, a year early.
Call it now. Time is the enemy.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.h2: Second illusion: your meridians are torn. Someone offers a forbidden pill to climb back in a day.
Refuse, and begin again from the first breath.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.h3: Third illusion: your gifted disciple wants to leap realms as you once did.
Push them; talent must be used.
Tell them about the night of the ninth bolt.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.k1: I was the fastest genius of my sect. In twenty years I leapt three realms. I could not wait for anything, least of all a heavenly tribulation.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.k2: I called down my tribulation before its time. The ninth bolt tore my meridians. I fell from Golden Core to Qi Refining in a single night.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.k3: For forty years I climbed again, slowly, one breath at a time. The second time I waited for heaven to call me. The fastest lightning is the one that knows when to wait for the cloud.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.mu: I am the remnant soul of Zi Dian, Violet Flash. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2.te: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_2_pa: I leave you my speed, together with my patience. Never use one without the other.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.da: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.go: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.h1: First illusion: a bolt too cruel falls toward your disciple.
Stand over them and take the bolt.
It is their trial, not yours.
Deflect the bolt to another disciple.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.h2: Second illusion: heaven offers you the title Lord of Thunder, if you never shield anyone again.
Keep your title; I have disciples.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.h3: Third illusion: the tenth bolt falls, just for you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.k1: I faced nine tribulations in my life and won them all. Lightning became my brother; I could call it from a clear sky.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.k2: At my disciples' tribulations, heaven sent bolts too cruel for them. I stood over them and took those bolts with my own body.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.k3: Heaven was angry that I stole its trial. It dropped a tenth bolt, just for me. I laughed and took it. True thunder protects; it does not frighten.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.mu: I am the remnant soul of Lei Zhen, Lord of Thunder. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3.te: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_lightning_3_pa: The thunder I leave you is not for frightening the world. It is for standing between the world and a heaven too cruel.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h1: First illusion: you carry two letters. One for a general, one for a mother. Only one can arrive.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h1.1: The general's; the war matters more.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h2: Second illusion: a guard offers money to read the letters you carry.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h2.1: Refuse and run through the shadows.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h3: Third illusion: you arrive too late for your own letter.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h3.2: Keep that letter, then carry the next one.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.h3.3: Curse the wind for being slow.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.k1: I carried letters in wartime, when families were split by the front line. No horse could cross it; I ran.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.k2: I learned to run with the wind and hide in the shadows of trees. For twelve years I carried eleven thousand letters. Not one was lost.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.k3: The last letter I carried was for me, from my mother, but I arrived too late. I have no regrets. Eleven thousand other mothers got their letters in time.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Feng Xiao, Little Wind. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_1_pamit: The wind never stops for itself. That is why it reaches everywhere.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h1: First illusion: the next contract is a sleeping child.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h1.1: Finish it; a contract is a contract.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h1.2: Ask why, then carry the child away.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h2: Second illusion: the child is grown and wants to know who protected them.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h2.1: Show yourself and ask for thanks.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h3: Third illusion: another shadow offers peace if you return to the Black Market.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.h3.2: Refuse. My shadow is for shelter now.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.k1: I was the best assassin of the Black Market. Never failed, never seen, never asked.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.k2: Until one night the contract was a child, heir of a small clan. For the first time I asked: why? Then I took the child and ran.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.k3: For twenty years other shadows hunted me. I guarded that child until adulthood, from the shadows, without them ever knowing who I was. Even the darkest shadow can be a shelter.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Ye Ying, Night Shade. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_2_pamit: Hide when you must, but make sure whoever shelters in your shadow can sleep soundly.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.h1: First illusion: you have just saved a village. They ask who their saviour was.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.h1.3: Leave a sign so they remember.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.h2: Second illusion: your own shadow stands up and challenges you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.h2.2: Admit it is your longing to be seen.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.h3: Third illusion: someone else is praised for your deed.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.k1: I mastered wind and shadow until I could walk anywhere unseen. I used that power to steal praise: I let people know who had helped them.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.k2: The more praise, the darker my shadow grew. One day my own shadow stood up and tried to replace me. It was all my longing to be seen.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.k3: I defeated it not with a sword, but by helping a thousand people with no one knowing. My shadow thinned and vanished. The power of the wind is moving the world unseen.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Wu Ying, The Shadowless. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_shadow_3_pamit: Move like the wind: everyone feels you, no one needs to see you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h1: First illusion: a storm closes every road, and a child cries beyond the mountain.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h1.1: Wait for the storm to pass.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h1.2: Open the door with a heart that wishes to arrive.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h2: Second illusion: you could open a door into the sect treasury.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h2.1: Open it; no one will know.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h2.2: A door is a trust, not a shortcut.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h3: Third illusion: the sect offers to make you an elder, leaving the gate.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.h3.2: Stay at the gate; someone is still lost outside.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.k1: I was the gatekeeper of a small sect. My work was opening and closing a door, and I did it for forty years.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.k2: One night a child was lost beyond the mountain, and a storm closed every road. I stared at my door and asked: why can a door open onto only one place?
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.k3: I opened that door, and behind it was the place where the child was crying. Space is only a fold of paper to someone who truly wishes to arrive.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Lu Zhi, Keeper of the Mountain Door. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
For every door you open, remember where the one waiting behind it wants to go home.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h1: First illusion: soldiers come. Your rift holds only half the refugees.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h1.2: Force the rift wider, though your qi tears.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h1.3: Close the rift and flee alone.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h2: Second illusion: eleven years pass. An elder offers medicine so you can leave the rift for a while.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h2.1: Leave for a while; they will be fine.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h2.2: Stay. A door left behind may close.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h2.3: Tell the refugees to fend for themselves.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h3: Third illusion: the war is over. The rift will close with you inside.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h3.2: Let the last refugee out first.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.h3.3: Pull someone in to keep you company.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.k1: When war burned the southern province, I opened a pocket world, a small rift between spaces, and hid three thousand refugees inside it.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.k2: Keeping the rift open drained my qi every day. I could not move, could not advance, could not leave. For nineteen years I was a door that must not close.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.k3: The last refugee walked out when the war ended. The rift closed with me inside it. The widest space is not the one you rule, but the one you give away.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Xu Kong, Keeper of the Rift. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
If you can open space, open it for those who have no place.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.h1: First illusion: you can be in a thousand places at once.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.h2: Second illusion: your old neighbour asks for help mending a roof, while the world calls you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.h3: Third illusion: heaven opens a gate to the immortal realm, but you must leave your village forever.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.h3.2: Close the gate politely and go home for supper.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.h3.3: Take the whole village with you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.k1: I could step anywhere in a single stride: the highest peak, the deepest sea, the edge of the world. Distance meant nothing to me.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.k2: So I never stayed anywhere. I saw a thousand cities but knew not one neighbour. I was everywhere, and therefore nowhere.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.k3: At the end of my life I chose one small village and lived there thirty years without stepping out. For the first time, I arrived. The highest space is not mastering distance, but choosing a place to stand.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Tai Xu, The Great Void. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_space_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
You will be able to go anywhere. Do not forget to come home.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h1: First illusion: a great sect master offers you a hundred techniques if you forget the one form you have trained.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h1.2: One form understood outweighs a hundred memorised.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h2: Second illusion: bandits hold the ferry passengers hostage. Their leader laughs at the prow.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h2.1: Stand between the bandits and the passengers, sword drawn.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h2.2: Cut down the leader as fast as possible, whatever happens.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h2.3: Leap into the river and go for help.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h3: Third illusion: your sword snaps in two mid-fight.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h3.1: A sword is only iron. The form lives in my hand.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.h3.2: Surrender. Without a sword I am nothing.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.k1: I was a ferryman's son at the Misty River crossing. When I was nine, bandits burned my father's boat. A wanderer gave me one sword form, only one, and left without a name.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.k2: For thirty years I cut the river mist every dawn with the same form. People laughed: "One form? Sect brats know a hundred." I did not answer. The dew on my blade answered.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.k3: When the beast tide came to the crossing, I stood on the pier. One form, ten thousand times. The river split for a moment, and the last boat reached the far bank. I did not. I have no regrets.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Hua Qingfeng, Morning Dew Sword. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_1.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
Go. If one dawn you see dew on the tip of your blade, that is me nodding.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h1: First illusion: your master's killer kneels before you, old and blind, begging for his life.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h1.1: Strike. An oath is an oath.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h1.2: Let him live with what he did.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h2: Second illusion: your disciple begs to inherit the vengeance.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h2.1: I pass it on; vengeance must be paid.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h2.2: Teach them to hold a hilt, not a hatred.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h2.3: Tell them to find their own.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h3: Third illusion: someone holds out the scabbard you once threw into the abyss.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h3.1: Take the scabbard and sheathe your sword.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.h3.2: Throw it into the abyss again.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.k1: My master was murdered the night I became a core disciple. I swore never to sheathe my sword until the killer was dead. I threw the scabbard into the abyss.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.k2: For twenty years I carried that naked blade. It cut enemies, then friends, then my own hand each time I slept. My disciples learned to hate before they learned to hold a hilt.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.k3: When at last I found the killer, he was old, blind and selling firewood. I went home without striking, and for the first time I slept without a wound. A sword without a scabbard cuts its owner first.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Ling Xuanyi, The Unsheathed Blade. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_2.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
Sheathe your sword every night, even when you are angry. Especially when you are angry.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.dalam: Guardian puppets test your strength, glyph tablets test your understanding. Both only repeat the question you already answered with your heart.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.goyah: Your heart wavers, and the illusion collapses around you. Calm your breath. This trial waits as long as you need.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h1: First illusion: the city gate is shut out of fear of you. Inside, sick people need you.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h1.1: Split the gate with your sword.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h1.2: Leave your sword outside and knock unarmed.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h1.3: Leave; they do not deserve help.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h2: Second illusion: a child wants to touch your sword.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h2.1: Shout at the child to keep away.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h2.2: Turn the blade and let them touch its spine.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h3: Third illusion: heaven offers you invincibility, if you remain forever alone.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h3.1: I accept. The strongest are always alone.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h3.2: I refuse. Strength that cannot be shared is useless.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.h3.3: I accept, and I will find friends later.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.k1: I cut down a falling star that was about to strike the City of a Thousand Bridges. The sky split, and the city was saved. I became the strongest sword of my age.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.k2: But my sword intent was too sharp. Birds fell from branches as I passed. Children wept when I smiled. The city I saved closed its gates whenever I came.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.k3: A hundred years later I learned to blunt myself. A sword that protects must be approachable. A sword that cannot be approached is only another falling star.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.k3.1: I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.mulai: I am the remnant soul of Jian Wuya, Boundless Sword Sovereign. Show me you are worthy of my legacy.
I am ready for the Heart Trial.
kultivator.cerita.warisan_sword_3.teguh: Your heart holds. Two trials await you in the inner chambers: Strength, and Comprehension.
I entrust my sword intent to you. Blunt it every morning, and it will be sharp when the world needs it.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_dou.itu: That is him! The one in the wide hat, pretending not to see us!
kultivator.cerita.wesel_dou.mulai: A money note? The nice paper someone used to buy thirty buns at once? That is Uncle Paper! He gives us sweets to keep quiet. The sweets are good...
kultivator.cerita.wesel_dou.mulai.1: Take me to him. I will double your sweets.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_pemalsu.mulai: Money notes? I know nothing about notes. ...Fine, fine! I only print them! Someone from the palace ordered the seal, a very polite man, with hands as cold as a fish.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_pemalsu.mulai.1: You are coming to the Yamen.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_pemalsu.mulai.2: (Extort him) A hundred spirit stones and I forget your face.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_pemalsu.peras: Here, here! Take it all! You never saw me!
kultivator.cerita.wesel_pemalsu.yamen: Do not hit me! I will come, I will come! That Magistrate Bao... he does not take bribes, does he? ...Of course not.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_tawar.bukti: Take this sample. The notes are being spent in the slums; the children there know everything and sell it all for a sweet.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_tawar.mulai: Someone is printing forged money notes with House Qian's seal. Three merchants were cheated, and a fourth wept at this desk this morning. House Qian does not weep, sir. House Qian collects.
kultivator.cerita.wesel_tawar.mulai.2: How do you know they are fake?
kultivator.cerita.wesel_tawar.tahu: The paper is too new. House Qian paper is sun-dried for a season so it never yellows. Swindlers are always in a hurry.
kultivator.cerita.xiao_mei_sapa.mulai: New commissions are posted. Confident in your skill? Oh, but before that, have you heard the latest?
kultivator.cerita.xiao_mei_sapa.siapa: Feng Ao, of course. He takes three at once and finishes two. The third he leaves to someone else so he can say they failed.
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.kumuh: They are right. Three times I asked father to open the granaries to the slums. Three times Minister Gu said the treasury was short. Then where does the money for the Grand Auction stage come from?
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.kumuh.1: Aren't you afraid to say that?
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.mulai: You are from outside, aren't you? Tell me, how do people beyond the walls see this palace?
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.mulai.1: They say the palace is far from the slums.
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.mulai.3: I do not know, my lady.
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.takut: Afraid? My cultivation is barely enough to light a candle. If I kept quiet too, what would be left of me?
kultivator.cerita.yan_ruyi_sapa.tertib: That order is paid for by people you never see. Next time, look at the street sweepers before dawn.
kultivator.cerita.yan_wushuang_pamit.mul: Tomorrow I leave for the mountains. Thirty years frozen; perhaps the spring of my cultivation is not yet too late. If you pass the northern slopes and see an old man meditating under a pine, do not wake him.
kultivator.cerita.yan_wushuang_sapa.lela: For thirty years I have not meditated a single night. My cultivation is frozen in one place, like a pond in winter. Sometimes I envy the beggars of the slums; at least they may choose where to sleep.
May you soon find your solitude.
kultivator.cerita.yan_wushuang_sapa.mula: Raise your head. Within these walls even a prince is only a guard who has stood watch too long.
How did this city come to be?
kultivator.cerita.yan_wushuang_sapa.peng: My daughter Ruyi has an upright heart, but a frail body. Minister Gu is able and beloved of the merchants. The guild council will choose; I can only hope they choose with open eyes.
kultivator.cerita.yan_wushuang_sapa.seja: Nine hundred years ago seven sects grew tired of war. They planted seven broken swords in the stone of the square and swore: "Within the walls, swords sleep." Since then the Warden Prince is chosen by the guild council, not born.
kultivator.cerita.yan_wushuang_sapa.sump: Fine, and heavy. Each time the oath is broken I am the one who must answer for the blood. Keep your sword asleep here.
kultivator.cerita.yun_fei_sapa.benar: Partly. The dragon was real. The rest... the wind above the clouds makes memories light.
kultivator.cerita.yun_fei_sapa.cerita: I once leapt along the back of a sleeping cloud dragon. Three times. On the third it woke, and I am still here, so clearly I won.
kultivator.cerita.yun_fei_sapa.mulai: Setting sail! See you above the clouds! Eh, you're not a passenger? Listen to my story anyway, it's free.
kultivator.cerita.yun_fei_sapa.rute: The sky palaces of allied sects, other capitals, the harbour city when the wind is kind. Pay at the booth, get your ticket stamped, don't look down.
